name: Heineken Original Lager
notes: World-renowned Dutch golden lager brewed with 100% pure malt, pristine water, selected hops, and Heineken's signature A-Yeast. Delivers a perfectly balanced crisp taste with subtle fruity green hop notes.

name: Lion Lager
notes: Sri Lanka's iconic golden lager brewed in the central highlands since 1881. Traditional brewing methods, roasted malt, and fine Styrian hops create a rich golden amber body with a frothy head, mild maltiness, and a clean refreshing finish.

name: Carlsberg Danish Pilsner
notes: Probably the best beer in the world. Crafted in Copenhagen since 1847 using Danish barley malt and aromatic hops. Features a crisp, refreshing profile with pleasant hoppy bitterness, subtle citrus aroma, and a light smooth malt body.

name: Corona Extra
notes: The world's quintessential beachside golden cerveza from Mexico. Light, sun-drenched golden color with a smooth, exceptionally clean palate, subtle corn sweetness, and refreshing dryness best crowned with a fresh wedge of lime.

name: Smirnoff Red, 700ml
notes: Triple distilled and filtered 10 times, the Smirnoff is the world’s best-selling vodka. Crystal clear in colour, the vodka has faint aromas of black pepper and charcoal.

name: Amarula African Gin
notes: Amarula African Gin is a fresh and fruity gin inspired by the wild marula fruit of Africa. It offers a bright and smooth taste with gentle citrus, soft spice and natural fruit notes.

name: Martell XO
notes: Martell XO Cognac is a luxurious French cognac with rich depth, smooth texture and elegant complexity. Crafted by the historic Martell house, this XO blends eaux-de-vie from the Borderies and Grande Champagne crus to create a bold yet refined style.

name: Martell Cordon Bleu
notes: Martell Cordon Bleu Cognac is a legendary French cognac known for its rich, smooth and elegant character. Created by the historic Martell house, this premium cognac offers deep aromas of candied fruit, plum, roasted nuts, spice and soft oak.

name: Calvet Varietals Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Calvet Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and expressive French red wine with a very intense garnet red-purple colour. The nose shows rich aromas of red fruit and blackcurrant, with spicy notes typical of Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Calvet Varietals Sauvignon Blanc
notes: Calvet Varietals Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh and expressive French white wine with a clear, pale yellow colour and delicate green hints. The nose offers bright aromas of white flowers, pineapple, tropical fruit and mineral notes.

name: Cycles Gladiator Pinot Noir
notes: Cycles Gladiator Pinot Noir is a bright and smooth American red wine with fresh fruit character. It opens with lively aromas of cherry and raspberry.

name: Cycles Gladiator Chardonnay
notes: Cycles Gladiator Chardonnay is a crisp and balanced American white wine with bright fruit and smooth oak character. It opens with aromas of toasted oak and soft butterscotch.

name: Piccini Chianti Riserva DOCG Collezione Oro
notes: Piccini Collezione Oro Chianti Riserva DOCG is a refined Tuscan red wine from Italy. It blends 90% Sangiovese with 10% Cabernet to create a rich and elegant style.

name: Piccini Vito Chardonnay
notes: Piccini Chardonnay is a fresh and easy-drinking Italian white wine with bright fruit character. It offers delicate floral aromas with notes of tropical fruit and citrus.

name: Penfolds Koonunga Hill Bin 28 Shiraz
notes: Penfolds Bin 28 Shiraz 2023 is a bold Australian Shiraz with ripe fruit, rich spice and classic Penfolds depth. First made in 1959, Bin 28 showcases warm-climate Shiraz from regions such as Barossa Valley, McLaren Vale and Padthaway.

name: Bottega Acino D’oro Chianti DOCG
notes: Bottega Acino d?Oro Chianti DOCG is a classic Italian red wine with an intense ruby red colour. It offers a complex bouquet with notes of ripe black berries, including blueberry, blackberry and currant.

name: Piccini Vito Merlot
notes: Piccini Vito Merlot is a smooth and juicy Italian red wine with a deep ruby red colour. It offers fruity aromas with gentle spice and subtle notes of green herbs and vegetables.

name: Piccini Vito Cabernet
notes: Piccini Vito Cabernet is a smooth and fruit-forward Italian red wine from Tuscany. Crafted by Tenute Piccini, this Cabernet offers fresh fruit notes with a soft and pleasant character.

name: Piccini Vito Syrah Rosé
notes: Piccini Vito Syrah Rosé is a fresh and fruit-forward Italian rosé wine from Tuscany. Crafted by Tenute Piccini using the French Syrah grape, this rosé offers a soft and balanced style with bright red fruit notes.

name: Glen Moray Elgin Classic Single Malt
notes: Glen Moray Elgin Classic Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a smooth and approachable single malt from Speyside, Scotland. Matured in oak casks, it offers gentle aromas of vanilla, butterscotch and soft fruit.

name: Sir Edwards Finest Blended Scotch Whisky, 1 Litre
notes: Sir Edwards Finest Blended Scotch Whisky is a smooth and approachable blended Scotch whisky with classic character. Crafted from a blend of malt and grain whiskies, it offers a balanced taste with gentle notes of cereal, oak, vanilla and light fruit.

name: Sierra Café Liqueur
notes: Sierra Café Tequila Liqueur blends Sierra Silver Tequila with the rich taste of natural roasted Mexican coffee. It offers a smooth balance of tequila fruitiness and bold coffee flavour.

name: Sierra Tequila Reposado
notes: Sierra Tequila Reposado is a golden Mexican tequila from Guadalajara. It is crafted from hand-picked Blue Weber Agave and offers a smooth, complex taste.

name: Sierra Tequila Silver
notes: Sierra Tequila Silver is a clear and vibrant Mexican tequila from Guadalajara. It is crafted from hand-picked Blue Weber Agave and offers a fresh, lively taste.

name: Benediktiner Weissbier 500ml Bottle
notes: The Benediktiner Weissbier is a top quality amber coloured German wheat beer. Organically produced using a traditional recipe originating from the Ettal Monastry in Bavaria, the beer has a tingly character with a balanced hoppy bitterness.

name: Chandon Brut
notes: Chandon Brut is a fresh and elegant sparkling wine crafted in the foothills of the Andes by Chandon Argentina, part of the prestigious Moët Hennessy group. Made from a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes, this sparkling wine shows lively aromas of citrus, green apple and white flowers.

name: Dassai 45 Sake, 720ml
notes: Dassai 45 Junmai Daiginjo Sake is an elegant and approachable premium sake from Japan, crafted by the renowned Dassai. This Junmai Daiginjo sake uses the prized Yamada-Nishiki rice variety, polished down to 45% of the original grain to create a refined and expressive flavour profile.

name: Dassai 39 Sake, 720ml
notes: Dassai 39 Junmai Daiginjo Sake is a refined and elegant premium sake from Japan, crafted by the renowned Dassai. This Junmai Daiginjo sake uses the prized Yamada-Nishiki rice variety, polished down to 39% of the original grain to create a pure and delicate flavour profile.

name: Pacheca Pink Port
notes: Pacheca Pink Port is a vibrant and refreshing Port wine from the Douro Valley in Portugal. Produced by Quinta da Pacheca, this pink Port is crafted from traditional Portuguese grape varieties including Tinta Roriz, Tinta Barroca, Touriga Nacional and Mourisco.

name: Heritage 1685 Sauvignon Blanc
notes: Heritage 1685 Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant South African white wine with bright fruit flavours and a refreshing mineral finish. This Sauvignon Blanc shows lively aromas of tropical fruit, grapefruit and fresh lime.

name: Heritage 1685 Shiraz
notes: Heritage 1685 Shiraz is a bold South African red wine inspired by the winemaking traditions of the Cape of Good Hope. This classic Shiraz shows rich aromas of plum, blackberry and mulberry with layers of ground pepper and warm spice.

name: Bottega Chardonnay IGT Trevenezie
notes: Bottega Chardonnay IGT Trevenezie is a fresh and elegant Italian white wine made from Chardonnay grapes grown in the Trevenezie region of northern Italy. The renowned Bottega produces this wine in Veneto using grapes from mineral-rich soils that help create balanced and aromatic wines.

name: Bottega Merlot IGT Trevenezie
notes: Bottega Merlot IGT Trevenezie is a smooth Italian red wine from the Trevenezie region in northern Italy. Bottega produces this Merlot in a rich and approachable style.

name: McGuigan Black Label Pinot Grigio
notes: McGuigan Black Label Pinot Grigio is a crisp and refreshing Australian white wine made from Pinot Grigio grapes. The award-winning McGuigan Wines creates this wine in a bright, easy-drinking style.

name: Marie Brizard Creme De Menthe
notes: Marie Brizard Crème de Menthe is a classic French mint liqueur with a bright and refreshing taste. The famous Marie Brizard brand makes it with natural peppermint for a clean and lively mint flavour.

name: Tall Horse Sauvignon Blanc
notes: Tall Horse Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and refreshing South African white wine known for its bright fruit flavours and easy-drinking style. Made from Sauvignon Blanc grapes grown in sunny vineyards, this lively wine offers fresh aromas of citrus, lime, gooseberry and passionfruit, followed by a light-bodied palate with notes of green apple and tropical fruit balanced by clean, zesty acidity.

name: The Glenlivet 18 Year Old, 1 Litre
notes: The Glenlivet 18 Year Old single malt combines tropical fruitiness and spicy complexity. This is the result of a combination of various cask types – first and second fill American Oak and Ex-Sherry Oak casks.

name: Test CYBS UC product
notes: Premium Test CYBS UC product curated from Other. Exceptional quality and authentic distillation character.

name: Olmeca Blanco Tequila
notes: Olmeca Silver Tequila is the original, no-nonsense tequila known for its crisp, clean character and easy drinkability. Made from 100% blue agave and unaged for freshness, it’s perfect for pre-game shots or mixing bright, zesty margaritas.

name: Marie Brizard Triple Sec
notes: Marie Brizard Triple Sec is a classic French orange liqueur made from a precise blend of bitter and sweet orange peels. It opens with a bright, fresh citrus aroma and delivers a clean, vibrant orange flavour on the palate.

name: Glenmorangie The Infinita 18 Year Old
notes: Glenmorangie The Infinita 18 Year Old celebrates endless flavour discovery. This exceptional whisky comes from nearly two decades of careful maturation and the limitless creativity of Dr.

name: Bacardi Reserva Ocho – 8 years Aged Rum
notes: The Bacardi Reserva Ocho is inspired from a family recipe dating back to 1862. The rum was created by the founder of Bacardi – Don Facundo Bacard? and was kept within the Bacardi family until a few years ago.

name: M. Chapoutier Les Meysonniers Rouge AOC
notes: From the legendary Rhône Valley in France, M. Chapoutier Les Meysonniers Rouge AOC is a pure expression of 100% Syrah from Crozes-Hermitage, one of the most respected appellations in the northern Rhône.

name: Louis Bernard Côtes du Rhône
notes: Crafted in the heart of France’s Rhône Valley, Louis Bernard Côtes du Rhône Rouge is a classic expression of the region’s warmth and charm. Made predominantly from Grenache and Syrah, this red wine captures the sun-drenched terroir of the southern Rhône — ripe, generous, and full of character.

name: The Bitter Truth Chocolate Bitters
notes: Crafted in Germany, The Bitter Truth Chocolate Bitters blend rich dark chocolate and roasted cacao with warm notes of vanilla, cinnamon, and gentle spice. This aromatic bitters adds a deep, velvety complexity to classic and modern cocktails alike — from Old Fashioned and Manhattan to rum or tequila creations.

name: Misiones de Rengo Merlot
notes: Produced in Chile’s fertile Central Valley, the Misiones de Rengo Merlot captures the approachable elegance and fruit-rich charm the varietal is known for. Crafted by the respected house of Misiones de Rengo in the Valle del Cachapoal / Central Valley region, this wine offers a smooth, balanced expression of 100 % Merlot that makes it ideal for everyday enjoyment or fine dining.

name: 3 Tres Medallas Chardonnay
notes: From Chile’s renowned Central Valley, 3 Tres Medallas Chardonnay is a seamless balance of freshness, fruit expression and light oak charm. Crafted by Viña Santa Rita, this wine reflects the house’s dedication to quality and the sun-lit purity of the region’s Chardonnay grapes.

name: The Botanist Islay Dry Gin
notes: The Botanist Islay Dry Gin is a remarkable exploration of Islay’s wild spirit. Distilled at the renowned Bruichladdie Distillery, this artisanal gin is handcrafted in small batches using a slow, meticulous distillation process.

name: Bruichladdich The Classic Laddie
notes: Bruichladdie The Classic Laddie is a modern expression of Islay whisky, crafted with integrity and purpose. Although Islay is famous for smoky drams, this single malt breaks tradition with an unpeated style that celebrates the natural character of Scottish barley.

name: Royal Brackla 12 Year Old
notes: Experience the refined elegance of Royal Brackla 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a prestigious Highland whisky renowned as one of Scotland’s original Royal Warrant holders. Aged for 12 years in the finest oak casks, this exceptional spirit delivers a harmonious balance of rich flavours and smooth complexity.

name: Bacardi Anejo Cuatro 4 Year Old Rum
notes: Discover the smooth sophistication of Bacardi Añejo Cuatro 4 Year Old Rum, a premium Bacardi rum expertly crafted and aged for a minimum of four years under the warm Caribbean sun. This golden rum delivers a perfectly balanced flavour profile with inviting notes of vanilla and cinnamon on the nose, a rich palate of dark honey, toasted oak, and clove, and a smooth, lingering toffee and oak finish.

name: Campo Viejo Rioja Reserva
notes: Campo Viejo Reserva Rioja is all about balance and tradition. Made from Tempranillo, Graciano, and Mazuelo grapes, it’s aged for at least three years — with 18 months in oak barrels and another 18 in the bottle — to bring out its signature depth and smoothness.

name: Stolichnaya Vanilla Vodka
notes: Stoli Vanilla delivers rich, sweet aromas and velvety vanilla flavor in every sip. Warm, creamy, and aromatic, it’s a dessert-like vodka that’s irresistibly smooth and satisfying.

name: Stolichnaya Raspberry Vodka
notes: Stolichnaya Raspberry Vodka bursts with the lush flavor of ripe raspberries and a touch of citrus zest. Sweet, tangy, and full-bodied, it’s like summer in a glass.

name: Stolichnaya Citrus Vodka
notes: Stolichnaya Citrus Vodka offers a bright, zingy burst of lemon and lime—sun-kissed and refreshingly bold. One of Stoli’s most popular flavors, it delivers crisp, citrusy intensity with every sip.

name: Misiones de Rengo Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Misiones de Rengo Sauvignon Blanc from Chile’s Central Valley is pale yellow with greenish hues and bursts with vibrant citrus and tropical fruit aromas. Notes of tomato leaf, grapefruit, pineapple, and mango shine through, backed by lively acidity and a clean, long finish.

name: Misiones de Rengo Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Crafted in Chile’s Central Valley, Misiones de Rengo Cabernet Sauvignon blends 85% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Syrah for a bold, fruit-forward experience. Aged 3 months in oak, it shows a deep ruby red color and intense aromas of berries, cherry, blackcurrant, vanilla, and chocolate.

name: Greater Than Gin
notes: Greater Than is India’s first Craft London Dry Gin, copper pot distilled in Goa using 9 botanicals sourced locally and globally. Crisp and clean, it opens with fresh juniper and lemon peel, a sweet hint of fennel on the palate, and a zingy ginger finish.

name: Alpaca Chardonnay
notes: Crafted in Chile’s Maule Valley, Alpaca Chardonnay is a vibrant white wine with golden hues and bold tropical aromas. Expect rich notes of pineapple, peach, banana, and a touch of vanilla.

name: Alpaca Merlot
notes: The Alpaca Merlot is a vibrant red wine with deep ruby hues. It features intense aromas of blackberries and plums, layered with subtle spice and vanilla notes.

name: Colombo No 9 Gin Miniature
notes: Colombo No 9 Gin Miniature brings together the expertise of two renowned Sri Lankan family owned companies – The gin making prowess of Rockland Distillers and the tea mastery of Dilmah. The gin has nine botanicals including juniper, coriander, cinnamon, and aromatic curry leaves with particular emphasis on the Dilmah Earl Grey tea leaves which brings in a floral and citrus profile to the flavourful gin.

name: Colombo No 8 Gin Miniature
notes: Colombo No 8 Gin Miniature is crafted with Ginseng as the eighth botanical to the Colombo No 7 Gin. Launched in 2024, the Year of the Dragon, the gin pays tribute to the historical Silk Route with a London dry gin that resurrects the recipe of a distilled, juniper-forward gin with a hint of spiciness.

name: Brokers Gin Miniature
notes: Brokers Gin is made to a 200 year old recipe in a 200 year old distillery. Containing the same traditional ten botanicals and?quadruple distilled spirit made from English wheat since inception, the gin is outstandingly smooth.

name: Campari Liqueur, 1 Litre – Pack of 25 Miniatures
notes: The Campari Liqueur Miniature is made from the infusion of herbs and fruits such as Chinotto and Cascarilla in alcohol and water. It is bitter, characterised by its dark red colour.

name: Campari Liqueur Miniature
notes: The Campari Liqueur Miniature is made from the infusion of herbs and fruits such as Chinotto and Cascarilla in alcohol and water. It is bitter, characterised by its dark red colour.

name: Versus White, 1 Litre
notes: The Versus White easy drinking sweet white blend with low alcohol and lots of ripe apple, peach, and other muscat fruit flavors for a fresh clean finish.

name: Ricard Pastis, 1 Litre
notes: Ricard Pastis is known to be France’s most popular and beloved spirit. In France, people simply order a “jaune” (yellow), knowing they’ll be served a Ricard Pastis.

name: Johnnie Walker Blonde
notes: Johnnie Walker Blonde is the newest addition to the infamous Johnnie Walker Range. It is the perfect drink for the summer, or perfect to drink if you’re just impatiently waiting for the summer to arrive.

name: Captain Morgan White Rum
notes: The Captain Morgan White Rum is the “New Captain of White Rum”. Made with fine Caribbean cane molasses and distilled for five times to ensure smoothness, this white rum is light, crisp making it a party favourite.

name: Smokey Monkey Blended Malt
notes: Monkey Shoulder Smokey Monkey Blended Malt gives a subtle oaky smoky aroma coupled with flavours of dry peaty notes intertwined with the signature creamy sweetness of the Original Monkey Shoulder Blended Malt. The recipe is a closely guarded secret – a been of the finest peated and non-peated single malt Scotch whiskies which makes for an exceptional whisky.

name: Colombo No 9 Gin
notes: Colombo No 9 Gin brings together the expertise of two renowned Sri Lankan family owned companies – The gin making prowess of Rockland Distillers and the tea mastery of Dilmah. The gin has nine botanicals including juniper, coriander, cinnamon, and aromatic curry leaves with particular emphasis on the Dilmah Earl Grey tea leaves which brings in a floral and citrus profile to the flavourful gin.

name: Tequila Rose Strawberry Cream
notes: Tequila Rose Strawberry Cream was the first original strawberry cream liqueur which combines tequila along with strawberry cream. The bold black glass keeps the light outside to ensure that the drink is delicious and fresh.

name: McGuigan Black Label Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The McGuigan Black Label Sauvignon Blanc is a fully favoured white wine with classic characteristics of a Sauvignon Blanc. The wine has bountiful aromas of passionfruit, cut grass and hints of peach.

name: Passion Pop Mixed Berry
notes: The Passion Pop Mixed Berry is an easy to drink sparkling wine with a combination of excellent fruit flavours with a Bubby personality. On the palate, the wine has aromas of berry and floral notes that make it enticing.

name: Passion Pop Watermelon
notes: The Passion Pop Watermelon is perfect for those who enjoy the sweet things in life. The watermelon flavour is the perfect beverage for the Sri Lankan climate.

name: Carlo Rossi California White
notes: The Carlo Rossi California White is a wine that is both crisp and light. The fragrant flavours of ripe pear add depth to give this wine a lasting appeal.

name: Chivas Regal XV Gold 15 Year Old
notes: The Chivas Regal XV Gold 15 Year Old is a refined, velvetty whisky that is aged for a minimum of 15 years. Part of this whisky that goes into the Chivas XV rests in cognac casks giving a truly velvetty, fruity, and luxurious finish.

name: Altivo Classic Malbec
notes: The Altivo Classic Malbec is an excellent wine from the Mendoza region of Argentina. Deep and bright red-violet hue in colour, the wine has an elegant nose with lush red fruits and spices.

name: Colombo No 8 Gin
notes: Colombo No 8 Gin is crafted with Ginseng as the eighth botanical to the Colombo No 7 Gin. Launched in 2024, the Year of the Dragon, the gin pays tribute to the historical Silk Route with a London dry gin that resurrects the recipe of a distilled, juniper-forward gin with a hint of spiciness.

name: Bellingham Homestead Pinotage
notes: Crafted in the heart of South Africa’s Western Cape, the Bellingham Homestead Pinotage is a rich and expressive red wine that embodies the country’s signature grape variety. Deep ruby in colour, it offers aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and hints of mocha and sweet spice.

name: 3 Tres Medallas Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The 3 Tres Medallas Sauvignon Blanc hails from the Central Valley terrior of the Chilean heartland. The wine has a light greenish-yellow hue.

name: 3 Tres Medallas Merlot
notes: The 3 Tres Medallas Merlot hails from the Central Valley terrior of the Chilean heartland. The wine has intense appearance of ruby-red and violet hues.

name: Brancott Estate Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Brancott Estate Sauvignon Blanc is a fantastic Sauvignon Blanc from the heart of New Zealand Marlborough Valley. The wine is predominantly has a pale straw hue with hints of green streaks.

name: Marcel Martin Rosé D’Anjou
notes: The Marcel Martin Rosé D’Anjou is made from Groulleau and Cabernet Franc Grapes. With a pale pink hue, the wine has floral and fruity aromas.

name: Grants Triple Wood with Glass
notes: While many whiskies gain their flavour from one cask, the Grants Triple Wood (formerly Grants Family Reserve) gets its distinct aroma and flavour from three different casks. Cask 1 – The Virgin Oak Casks that gives its spicy robustness Cask 2 – The American Oak Casks that provides the smoothness Cask 3 – The Bourbon Casks that offers the sweetness.

name: Chivas Regal 25 Year Old
notes: Chivas Regal 25 Year Old is regarded as the world’s first luxury whisky. Only the rarest 25-year-old Scotch whiskies are used in this historical blend.

name: Don Simon Seleccion Airen, 3 Litres
notes: The Don Simon Selecci?n Airen, 3 Litres is a young, bright, fruity white wine crafted for everyday drinking. The light and simple flavour make it ideal for sipping while enjoying a mean.

name: Don Simon Seleccion Tempranillo, 3 Litres
notes: The Don Simon Selecci?n Tempranillo, 3 Litres has an attractive ruby red hue. The wine has intense fruity aromas and flavours of red and black berries such as strawberries, blackberries, blueberries, blackcurrant, raspberries coupled with subtle hints of floral aromas such as roses and violets.

name: Tia Maria
notes: Tia Maria is crafted with 100% real arabica coffee beans from the tropics of Brazil, Jamaican rum, vanilla, and sugar. These ingredients come together beautifully by adding different facets to the liqueur – the coffee provides a distinctive roasted, full-bodied rich taste, while vanilla lends a pronounced but delicate, fragrant back note.

name: Jack Daniels Sinatra Select, 1 Litre
notes: Jack Daniels Sinatra Select pays tribute to a biggest fan of Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Whiskey – Frank Sinatra. The whisky is made in a unique type of barrels called “Sinatra Barrels”.

name: Auchentoshan 12 Year Old
notes: The Auchentoshan 12 Year Old is spectacular scotch that is first distilled thrice. The whisky is then matured for twelve years in bourbon and sherry casks in the Lowland region of Scotland.

name: Bowmore 12 Year Old
notes: The Bowmore 12 Year Old is a reflection of the essence of Bowmore – thrashing waves, windswept landscapes and generations of tradition which results in a both perfectly balanced and complex whisky. Warm amber in colour, the whisky has the trademark Bowmore peaty smokiness that perfectly complements the subtle aromas of lemon and honey.

name: Laphroaig Select
notes: The Laphroaig Select Cask is a careful hand-selected blend of single malts aged in Oloroso sherry butts, first-fill ex-Bourbon quarter casks and Pedro Ximenez sherry hogsheads at different levels of maturation. This is then finished in virgin American oak barrels.

name: Urakasumi Sake Junmaishu, 300ml
notes: The Urakasumi Sake Junmaishu is made with the Manamusume rice. This pure rice sake makes full use of the umami of the rice.

name: Urakasumi Sake Kiippon, 180ml
notes: The Urakasumi Sake Kiippon is made from the Sasanishiki rice that is locally harvested in Japan. It is considered an excellent table rice as it has the perfect balance of acidity and umami.

name: Passport Scotch Whisky
notes: With a creamy and fruity finish, the Passport Scotch Whisky is a well balanced blended scotch with remarkable smoothness.

name: Hendricks Gin Miniature
notes: The Hendrick’s Gin is infused with more than 11 botanicals coupled with essences of rose and cucumber to form a uniquely distilled gin. The gin is made in batches of 500 liters at a time to control the quality of the range.

name: Jacobs Creek Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Jacobs Creek Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and refreshing Sauvignon Blanc that is perfect accompaniment to any occassion. Fragrant aromas of passionfruit and varietal asparagus lift the nose.

name: Jacobs Creek Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Part of the classic range, the Jacobs Creek Cabernet Sauvignon is a fantastic easy to drink red wine with aromas of black pepper, chocolate, and red berries. On the palate, the wine offers flavours of fresh red fruit with textured tannins, and integrated oak complexity.

name: Jacobs Creek Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Jacobs Creek Reserve Sauvignon Blanc is made from the finest fruit from Australia’s best wine regions giving rise to a fresh Sauvignon Blanc that has a fine line acidity with a long finish. The wine has expressive aromas of lime with hints of guava coupled with slight hints of nettle and snow pea.

name: Penfolds Bin 2 Shiraz Mataro
notes: First released in 1960, the Penfolds Bin 2 Shiraz Mataro is made of 80% Shiraz and 20% Mataro grape varietals. The wine has a cerise core colour with a crimson rim.

name: Penfolds Koonunga Hill Chardonnay
notes: The Penfolds Koonunga Chardonnay is a medium bodied wine with a very lively and crisp palate. The oak aging provides a layer of complexity to this Chardonnay.

name: Yellow Tail Moscato
notes: The Yellow Tail Moscato is a light white wine that has bright fruit flavours, and a soft palate making it a refreshing drink. The moscato has aromas of white peach, passion fruit, and floral orange blossom.

name: Jack Daniels Tennessee Apple
notes: The Jack Daniels Tennessee Apple combines the unique character of the original Jack Daniels Tennessee Whisky and crisp green apples. This gives a fresh, rewarding taste.

name: Jack Daniels Tennessee Honey
notes: Blending the signature Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Whiskey with a unique honey liqueur brings the Jack Daniels Honey or Jack Daniels Tennessee Honey. This is unique whiskey has hints of honey and a naturally smooth finish.

name: Stolichnaya Vodka
notes: Since 1938, Stolichnaya has been the flag bearer of high quality vodka. Combining modern innovation, and creativity with century old traditions, the Stolichnaya Vodka is an exceptional classic.

name: Santa Helena Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5 Litres
notes: Santa Helena Cabernet Sauvignon has a beautiful dark red ruby colour. The intense flavours and aromatic notes of cherry and blackcurrant perfectly blends together with lighter chocolate and vanilla notes.

name: Chateau Cantin Saint-Emilion Grand Cru
notes: The Chateau Cantin Saint-Emilion Grand Cru is an excellent French wine. The wine is characterised by a garnet hues with sustained shades of purple.

name: The Macallan Double Cask 18 Year Old
notes: The Macallan Double Cask 18 Year Old is a distinctive single?with a sweeter, warmer taste and character. This?perfectly balanced single malt scotch whisky is matured for a minimum of 18 years in American Oak casks and European Oak casks that are both sherry seasoned.

name: The Macallan Double Cask 15 Year Old
notes: The Macallan Double Cask 15 Year Old is a well balance single malt Scotch whisky that is crafted by harmoniously bringing together two oaks into one exceptional single malt. The Sherry seasoned Amercian oak casks adds delicate vanilla flavours while the Eurpoean oak casks bring out the subtle spice.

name: The Macallan Double Cask 12 Year Old
notes: The Macallan Double Cask 12 Year Old is aged for a minimum of 12 years. A perfect marriage between 100% sherry seasoned American Oak casks and European Oak casks.

name: Clan MacGregor
notes: This whisky of exceptional quality is a skillful blend of fifteen of the finest Scottish malt and grain whiskies. Clan Macgregor Scotch whisky has a delicate, sweet aroma and a smooth, mellow taste which has won many awards over the years.

name: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old – Vivienne Westwood
notes: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old collaborated with legendary designer Vivenne Westwood and launched this limited edition?Chivas Regal 18 Years – Vivienne Westwood bottle at the 2011 London Fashion Week. The bottle is encased in a cleverly folded silk bag based on the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar flag along with a taffeta rosette with an enamel badge.

name: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old – Pininfarina Chapter 1
notes: Chivas Regal 18 Year Oldcollaborated with Pininfarina, luxury Italian automobile designers to product this limited edition variant. The sleek exterior case, known as “The Drop” pays tribute to the oak barrels, air and liquid.

name: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old – Alexander McQueen
notes: Chivas Brothers partnered with late British designer Alexander McQueen to create this limited edition bottle of their 18 Year Old Gold Signature. The bottle has a beautiful cap in Union Jack colours that doubles as a cup.

name: Chateau Minuty M Rosé
notes: The Minuty M Ros? is classic C?tes de Provence ros? – a style that was perfected Chateau Minuty catapulting the winery to the top of premium rose wine makers. The grapes are entirely handpicked to ensure the integrity of the fruit.

name: Yamazaki 12 Year Old Single Malt
notes: The Yamazaki 12 Year Old Single Malt is the flagship single malt of the House of Suntory. Crafted in Japan’s first and oldest malt distillery, the whisky is aged in American, Spanish, and Japanese Mizunara oak.

name: Yamazaki Single Malt
notes: The Yamazaki Single Malt is the flagship single malt of the House of Suntory. Crafted in Japan’s first and oldest malt distillery, the whisky is aged in American, Spanish, and Japanese Mizunara oak.

name: Roku Gin
notes: The Roku Gin is perfectly balanced gin that combines six distinctive Japanese botanicals with eight traditional botanicals. The Japanese botanicals – Sakura flower, Sakura leaf, Yuzu peel, Sencha tea (green tea), Gyokuro tea (refined green tea) and Sansh_ pepper are cultivated over four seasons and harvested at the peak of the season to extract the best flavour and then distilled to create the perfect Japanese Gin.

name: Glenfarclas 15 Year Old
notes: The Glenfarclas 15 Year Old is a favourite of the William Grant family and is perfect for single malt enthusiasts. Rich, golden amber in colour, the whisky has complex aromas of sherried, light butterscotch, and hints of dried fruit.

name: Glenfarclas 12 Year Old
notes: The Glenfarclas 12 Year Old has vibrant amber gold colour. Fresh and light aromas of sherried fruit fill the nose coupled with spicy sweetness with hints of oak.

name: Glenfarclas 10 Year Old
notes: The Glenfarclas 10 Year Old is matured completely in olorosso sherry casks. Vibrant and straw gold in colour, thw whisky has tempting sweet sherry aromas that combine well with delicate aromas such as subtle supeces, honey, vanilla, and pear drops.

name: The Balvenie PortWood 21 Year Old
notes: The Balvenie PortWood 21 Year Old is a marriage of rare Balvenie whisky transfeered to port casks that have previously held port wines. The malt master ensures that the right of character is imparted by the port casks such that it enhances and develops the single malt while preserving the orignal characteristics.

name: The Balvenie Caribbean Cask 14 Year Old
notes: The Balvenie Caribbean Cask 14 Year Old is first matured in traditional oak whisky casks for 14 years and then finished in casks that previously held Caribbean rum. This results in a beyond exceptional single malt which is smooth and has the typical honeyed character of Balvenie but also has notes of toffee and fruit with a warm, lingering, finish.

name: The Balvenie DoubleWood 12 Year Old
notes: The Balvenie DoubleWood 12 Year Old is crafted by taking whisky that has matured in traditional whisky casks such as American Oak ex-bourbon barrels and hogsheads for at least twelve?years and then further maturing them in Spanish Oak ex-Oloroso sherry casks for a further 9 months. This whisky is then transferred to larger oak vessels to allow the whiskies from individual casks to marry.

name: Loch Lomond Single Grain
notes: The Loch Lomond Single Grain Whisky is distilled to perfection by using only the finest malted barley. The distillation happens on continuous stills where the whisky gains the smooth and sweet character.

name: Loch Lomond Original Single Malt
notes: The Loch Lomond Original Single Malt is an incredibly smoooth and easy drinking Scotch. The whisky is matured oak casks which develops the honey and citrus notes.

name: The Bitter Truth Jerry Thomas Own Decanter Bitters
notes: The Bitter Truth Jerry Thomas Own Decanter Bitters is based on a recipe by the most important bartender of the 19th century – Prof Jerry Thomas. The bitters have aromas of cider candies, crystallized ginger, fresh tangerine oil and almonds.

name: The Bitter Truth Celery Bitters
notes: The Bitter Truth Celery Bitters enriches cocktails in an unusual savoury flavour. Aromas of white grapes, celery leaf, lemongrass and ginger root entice the nose.

name: The Bitter Truth Lemon Bitters
notes: The Bitter Truth Lemon Bitters add the liveliness and freshness of lemons into every cocktail. Aromas of hot lemon tea and honey fill the nose.

name: The Bitter Truth Orange Bitters
notes: The Bitter Truth Orange Bitters are a combination of bitter and sweet orange peel coupled with several herbs and spices macerated in alcohol. Aromas of traditional marmalade are followed by spices of sweet cinnamon and nutmeg.

name: The Bitter Truth Aromatic Bitters
notes: The Bitter Truth Aromatic Bitters are the classic bitters with its significance dating back to the 18th century. The bitters have a complex flavours such as cinnamon, cardamom, and anise.

name: Frangelico Hazelnut Liqueur
notes: The richness of Frangelico Hazelnut Liqueur is based on its origin. The liqueur is predominantly made from a blend of top of the line hazelnuts from Italy.

name: McGuigan Black Label Chardonnay Miniature
notes: The McGuigan Black Label Chardonnay is smooth wine with a creamy palate. The wine has aromas and tastes of sweet tropical fruit and melon flavours with subtle notes of vanilla.

name: McGuigan Black Label Merlot Miniature
notes: The McGuigan Black Label Merlot is an smooth, flavoursome wine with ripe characters of cherrys, plums, and raspberries. Subtle but discernable notes of oak and vanilla can also be seen with the wine.

name: St Remy VSOP Miniature
notes: A fine brandy with a well balanced, smooth taste and distinctive French brandy character. St-Remy uses eau-de-vie distilled from eight grape varieties, which are aged 1-2 years, of which 6 months are spent exclusively in small 200 litre oak barrels.

name: Smirnoff Red Miniature
notes: Triple distilled and filtered 10 times, the Smirnoff is the world’s best-selling vodka. Crystal clear in colour, the vodka has faint aromas of black pepper and charcoal.

name: Russian Standard Vodka Miniature
notes: Hailing from the home of vodka – Russia, the Russian Standard Vodka is the benchmark for excellenct vodka. Distillided multiple times and filtered four times with charcoal, the spirit is exceptionally pure and delicious.

name: Remy Martin VSOP Miniature
notes: The Remy Martin VSOP stands as a symbol of the expertise of the cognac making house founded in 1724. The champagne fine cognac has intense aromas of vanilla due to the aging in French Limousine oak barrels coupled with notes of baked apple, floral notes, and ripe apricot.

name: Monkey Shoulder Miniature
notes: Looking for whiskey to make cocktails? Look no further as the Monkey Shoulder Blended Malt with its fruity aromas and mellow vanilla is perfect for mixing and crafting cocktails. Now in a 50ml small monkey sized miniature.

name: Johnnie Walker Red Label Miniature
notes: Johnnie Walker Red Label is Johnnie Walker’s pioneer blend. The versatile one that has introduced Johnnie Walker whisky to the world.

name: Gordons Dry Gin Miniature
notes: An absolute classic dry gin, Gordon’s Dry Gin is one of the best selling spirits in the world. This triple-distilled gin is made from botanicals such as juniper berries, coriander, Angelica.

name: Glenfiddich 18 Year Old Miniature
notes: The Glenfiddich 18 Year Old is matured in fine Olorosso Sherry Casks and American Oak Casks. This beings about an incredibly fruity and and oaky whisky.

name: Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Miniature
notes: The Glenfiddich 15 Year Old is a testament of Glenfiddich’s tradition of innovation. The whisky is aged in European oak sherry casks and new oak casks which is then mellowed by the Solera Vat.

name: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old Miniature
notes: The Glenfiddich is matured in American Oak and European Oak Casks for a minimum of 12 years. This provides it’s signature sweet and subtle oak flavors.

name: El Jimador Reposado Miniature
notes: The El Jimador Reposado Tequila is a 100% blue weber agave Tequila. The golden colour is a result of a two month maturation in handmade American Oak Barrels.

name: Colombo No 7 Gin Miniature
notes: Colombo No 7 Gin was invented out of necessity when spice trade routes were closed during the second world war. Crafted to a 70 year old timeless recipe including four botanicals native to Sri Lanka, this gin wrecked the stereotype that a good gin cannot be produced outside the UK.

name: Cointreau Miniature
notes: With a recipe unchanged since 1875, the Cointreau contains only four ingredients – orange peels, sugar, water, and alcohol). Distilled in traditional methods with a unique blend of bitter and sweet orange peels, Cointreau is crafted as the perfect orange liqueur.

name: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old Miniature
notes: Smooth, rich, and generous are the perfect three words to describe a Chivas Regal 12 Year Old whisky. Comprised of malt and grain whiskies that have been aged for a minimum of 12 years, the whisky has notes of vanilla, ripe apple, and honey.

name: Ceylon Arrack Miniature
notes: Distilled from the sap of the coconut flower and aged in Halmilla Wood. Ceylon Arrack is one of Sri Lanka’s finest Arracks.

name: Ballantines 12 Year Old
notes: The Ballantine’s 12 Year Old was crafted for people with a deep passion and appreciation for whisky by people with a deep passion and appreciation for whisky. This whisky has a golden honey hue with aromas of sweet honey with hints of vanilla and oak.

name: Vegaverde 5° Blanco Sparkling
notes: The Vegaverde 5? Blanco Sparkling is a white sparkling wine from Spain made from Airen grapes. Pale yellow in colour, the wine has aromas of fruit cocktails and stone fruit.

name: El Sotillo Tinto Cosecha
notes: The El Sotillo Tinto Cosecha is made from a blend of Tempranillo and Garnacha. Bright red hue in colour, with aromas of ripe cherry, strawberries, and liquorice.

name: Don Simon Seleccion Airen
notes: The Don Simon Seleccion Airen is a young, bright, fruity white wine crafted for everyday drinking. The light and simple flavour make it ideal for sipping while enjoying a mean.

name: Don Simon Seleccion Tempranillo
notes: The Don Simon Seleccion Tempranillo has an attractive ruby red hue. The wine has intense fruity aromas and flavours of red and black berries such as strawberries, blackberries, blueberries, blackcurrant, raspberries coupled with subtle hints of floral aromas such as roses and violets.

name: McGuigan Private Bin Moscato
notes: The McGuigan Private Bin Moscato is a light and fresh wine with natural fruit sweetness. The wine portals a beautiful blend of floral and pineapple flavours making it a perfect aperitif or everyday wine.

name: Aperol
notes: Made from a perfect blend of oranges coupled with high quality roots and herbs, the Aperol is bittersweet apertif with a bright orange hue. The recipe has remained a secret to date.

name: Kavalan Classic Single Malt
notes: The Kavalan Classic Single Malt is the flagship whisky of the Kavalan Distillery which portrays the sheer quality of whisky made in Taiwan. Amber in colour, the whisky elegant and clean aromas of floral notes coupled with hints of honey and tropical fruits.

name: Makers Mark
notes: Makers Mark is an easy to drink bourbon. Instead of the usual rye, this premium bourbon is made from soft red winter wheat making it a unique, fully flavoured bourbon.

name: Brancott Estate Pinot Noir
notes: The Brancott Estate Pinot Noir is an excellent Marlborough Pinot Noir from the grassy highlands of New Zealand. Bright ruby red in colour, the wine has aromas of vanilla, red berry fruits and oak.

name: Nederburg The Winemasters Carignan Grenache Rosé
notes: The Nederburg The Winemasters Carignan Grenache Ros? is made with a combination of Grenache (82%) and Carignan (18%) grape varietals. Blush pink in colour, the wine has tempting aromas of orange melon, peach, subtle hints of caramel coupled with pomegranate and cherry.

name: Nederburg The Winemasters Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Nederburg The Winemasters Sauvignon Blanc is made with a combination of Sauvignon Blanc (92%) and Semillon (8%) grape varietals. Crisp clear with streaks of lime green in colour, the wine has aromas of flint and herbs coupled with hints of lemon zest and granadilla.

name: Nederburg The Winemasters Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: The Nederburg The Winemasters Cabernet Sauvignon is made of Cabernet Sauvignon (86%), Cabernet Franc (6%), Petit Verdot (3.8%), Other varieties (4.2%). Ruby red in colour, and has aromas of dark ripe red fruits, coupled with hints of fine space, oak, and nuts.

name: Chateau Toutigeac Bordeux Blanc
notes: The Chateau Toutigeac Bordeux Blanc is made from a blend of 50% Sauvignon Blanc, 40% Semillion, ?and 10% Muscadelle varietals. Bright greenish colour, the wine has exotic fruit flavours with hints of minerals.

name: Black & White Blended Scotch, 1 Litre
notes: Featuring two dogs – a black Scottish Terrier and a white West Highland White Terrier on its label, the Black & White Blended Scotch is a famed blended scotch whisky made since the 1890’s. Pale gold in colour, the whisky has flavours and aromas of oak, honey, and vanilla with hints of peat.

name: Pernod Anise
notes: Pernod Anise is the oldest anise liqueur in France. This liqueur is made from distilling star anise, fennel and 14 other botanicals including mint and coriander.

name: Bottega Prosecco Spumante DOCG
notes: The Bottega Prosecco Spumante DOCG is a brut sparkling wine made with 100% Glera grapes by the traditional method. Beautiful straw yellowish gold in colour, the process has fine and consistent perlage.

name: Belvedere Pure Luminous Night Sabre, 6 Litres
notes: Crafted with 600 years of Polish vodka making tradition, the Belvedere Vodka is the epitome of luxury vodka. Made with 100% Polish Dankowskie Rye and 0% additives including sugar or glycerine, this vodka is completely natural.

name: Belvedere Pure Luminous Night Sabre, 3 Litres
notes: Crafted with 600 years of Polish vodka making tradition, the Belvedere Vodka is the epitome of luxury vodka. Made with 100% Polish Dankowskie Rye and 0% additives including sugar or glycerine, this vodka is completely natural.

name: 1800 Silver Tequila
notes: The 1800 Silver Tequila is named after the year it was founded – 1800. For over 200 year, the brand has made tequila without compromise, using only the finest blue weber agave harvested at its peak.

name: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old, 4.5 Litres
notes: Smooth, rich, and generous are the perfect three words to describe a Chivas Regal 12 Year Old. Comprised with malt and grain whiskies which have been aged for a minimum of 12 years, the whisky has notes of vanilla, ripe apple, and honey.

name: Corralejo Tequila Reposado
notes: The Corralejo Tequila Reposado is made from hand harvested 100% Blue Weber Agave from fields in the state of Guanajuato. The tequila is distilled twice using the Charentais distillation method.

name: Corralejo Tequila Silver
notes: The Corralejo Tequila Silver is made from hand harvested 100% Blue Weber Agave from fields in the state of Guanajuato. The tequila is not aged and is bottled fresh after double distillation using the Charentais distillation method.

name: Penfolds Koonunga Hill 76 Shiraz Cabernet
notes: The Penfolds Koonunga Hill 76 Shiraz Cabernet is made of 85% Shiraz and 15% Cabernet Sauvignon Varietals. The Penfolds winemaking mastery is seen in the perfect bold and spicy blend of both the varietals.

name: Carlo Rossi Sweet Moscato
notes: The Carlo Rossi Moscato Sweet White is a sweet fruity light bodies white wine. The wine is layered with floral notes with hints of stone fruits and tree fruits.

name: Carlo Rossi Sweet Sangria
notes: The Carlo Rossi Sweet Sangria has distinguishing bright fruit flavours with a lot of personality. Refreshing aromas and flavours of citrus fruits such as orange, grapefruit, lemon can be noticed.

name: Carlo Rossi California White, 1.5 Litres
notes: Carlo Rossi California White is a popular table wine in California. Semi-dry in style, the wine has a well balanced palate, and smooth taste.

name: Cono Sur Tocornal Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Cono Sur Tocornal Sauvignon Blanc has a medium straw hue with aromas of berries, nuts, and citrus. The palate is filled with grapefruit flavours and ends with a dry finish.

name: Belvedere Citrus
notes: The Belvedere Citrus Vodka is made by steeping citrus peels, Italian and Argentine lemons, and Mexican limes into the distinctive Belvedere Vodka. This gives a fresh and bright flavour to the vodka.

name: Jam Jar Sweet Red Blend
notes: The Jam Jar Sweet Red Blend brings the Jam Jar Experience to the Cabernet Sauvignon enthusiast. This sweet wine is made with a blend of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Shiraz varietals.

name: Ciroc Vodka, 3 Litres
notes: The Ciroc Vodka is fermented from French grapes in an innovative cold fermentation process. The spirit is then distilled five times to achieve the epitome of smoothness.

name: Cardhu 18 Year Old
notes: The Cardhu 18 Year Old is a rich and elegant whisky that takes its time to unveil its delicate, fruity, and rich character. The whisky is rich in body and full of delicate Cardhu character with aromas of chocolate and rich fruit coupled with complex fruity aromas such as plums, pears, currant and a hint of pineapple.

name: Johnnie Walker John Walker & Sons XR 21
notes: The Johnnie Walker John Walker & Sons XR 21 was crafted to honour the knighthood of master blender Alexandaer Walker II, who like his father and grandfather before him decidicated their entire lives to making exceptional whiskies. The whisky is inspired by handwritten notes of Sir Alexander’s own handwritten notes and contains exclusive and rare whiskies that have been aged for a minimum of 21 years.

name: Woodford Reserve, 1 Litre
notes: The Woodford Reserve Straight Bourbon Whisky has mastered the craft of fine bourbon making since 1812. This perfectly balanced whisky has more than 200 flavour notes ranging from bold grain and wood to sweet spice, aromatics, floral, and fruity notes.

name: Teeling Single Malt Irish Whiskey
notes: The Teeling Single Malt Irish Whiskey is a symphony of flavour. The cask make up of the single malt contains wine casks used to make the following varietals – Cabernet Sauvignon, White Burgundy, Madiera, Port, and Sherry giving out different flavours that opens up a fireworks of flavours.

name: Teeling Single Grain Whiskey
notes: The Teeling Single Grain Whiskey is made from 95% corn and 5% malted barley. The whiskey is matured in 100% Californian Cabernet Sauvignon Barrels.

name: Teeling Small Batch Whiskey
notes: The Teeling Small Batch Whiskey is the flagship whiskey of the Teeling Brand. The grain and malt whiskies are initially aged separately for up to 6 years in ex-bourbon barrels.

name: Maria Amoros Cava Brut
notes: The Maria Amoros Cava Brut is a Spanish sparkling wine made in the traditional method. Comprising of the finest grape varietals of Macabeo, Xarel lo, and Parellada ?from the Pened?s region of Spain, the sparkling wine carefully processed and is aged in the depths of the caves of Sant Sadurn? d’Anoia.

name: Glen Scotia 15 Year Old
notes: The Glen Scotia 15 Year Old is an exceptional single malt scotch that delivers the true Campbeltown taste. The whisky is made from unpeated malt is is matured initially in first fill bourbon casks and then in re-fill Amercian Oak casks.

name: Glen Scotia Double Cask
notes: The Glen Scotia Double Cask is a fantastic whisky into the world of Campbeltown Single Malt Scotch whisky. The whisky is initially matured in first fill bourbon barrels, and the finished for 12 months in Pedro Xim?nez Sherry Casks.

name: Grants 25 Year Old
notes: The Grants 25 Year Old is a blend of approximately 25 grain and malt whiskies which have been aged more than 25 years. Some whiskies in the blend belong to distilleries no longer in existence such as the Ladybrun distillery which closed in 1975.

name: Patron Reposado Tequila
notes: The Patron Reposado Tequila is aged in a variety of barrels between three to five months. This ensures a smooth taste with a hint of oak.

name: 4th Street Sweet Rosé
notes: The 4th Street Sweet Rose has a delightful strawberry pink colour. The wine has fascinating aromas of strawberries with is followed by luscious berry flavours on the palate.

name: 4th Street Sweet White
notes: The 4th Street Sweet White is a refreshing white wine. The wine is loaded with tropical fruity aromas on the nose and sweet flavours on the palate.

name: 4th Street Sweet Red
notes: The 4th Street Sweet Red is a refreshingly delicious and fruity red wine with a deep ruby hue. The wine is filled with aromas of blackcurrant.

name: Jose Cuervo Especial Reposado Tequila
notes: The Jose Cuervo Especial Reposado Tequila was the first ever Tequila that was created after Jos? Maria Guadalupe de Cuervo was granted land to grow the now famous Agave plant by the King of Spain in 1758. The reposado gets its distinct colour and flavour as it is aged in quality American oak for a minimum of two months.

name: Jose Cuervo Especial Silver Tequila
notes: The Jose Cuervo Especial Silver Tequila is crafted using blue agave from the family estate of Jose Cuervo in Jalisco, Mexico. The tequila is double-distilled for smooth, crisp, clean tequila.

name: The Glenlivet Captains Reserve, 1 Litre
notes: The Glenlivet Captains Reserve was inspired by Captain Bill Grant Smith, the great grandson of the founder George Smith. This single malt begins its journey from bourbon and sherry casks to selectively finish in cognac casks.

name: Ciroc Vodka, 6 Litres
notes: The Ciroc Vodka is fermented from French grapes in an innovative cold fermentation process. The spirit is then distilled five times to achieve the epitome of smoothness.

name: Absolut Elyx, 1.75 Litres
notes: Made from a wheat grown from a single estate in southern Sweden which has been growing wheat since 1400’s, the Absolut Elyx redefines luxury vodka. The vodka is made using a hand operated copper vintage column that has been in operation since 1921.

name: Absolut Vodka – LOVE Edition
notes: The Absolut Vodka – Love Edition is the ultimate expression of supporting a diverse, respectful world. A world where everyone has the freedom to express themselves without fear or discrimination.

name: Canadian Club 5 Year Old
notes: Canadian Club whisky is the leading whisky producer in Canada. This whisky has a distinct taste as it is matured in charred white oak barrels for six years.

name: Aberlour 16 Year Old
notes: The Aberlour 16 Year Old is a classic single malt that has a unique depth and complexity owing to 16 years of ageing in American Oak Casks and Sherry Casks. This also gives the whisky warm and fruity notes that are perfectly enhanced by spicy sweetness.

name: Kraemer Brut
notes: Pale straw yellow in colour, the Kraemer Brut is a fine French sparkling wine. The wine has soft and creamy flavors with fine bubbles.

name: Dewars 18 Year Old
notes: First Crafted in 2013, the Dewars 18 Year old whisky follows on the legacy of the founder – Sir John Dewar who realised that ageing the whisky longer in barrels made a significant difference in the taste. The Dewars 18 Year Old blend forges ahead on this path to create a blend that stands apart.

name: Star of Bombay
notes: The Star of Bombay is a bolder expression of the signature Bombay Sapphire. Made with 12 botanicals (two more than the Original Bombay Sapphire), this gin has a rich new dimension.

name: Grey Goose Original Vodka, 1 Litre
notes: Grey Goose Original Vodka, made from the finest French winter wheat and pure spring water from the Cognac region of France, is a vodka unlike any other. The vodka has a floral and delicate nose with a sweet and round palate.

name: Sandeman Ruby Port
notes: The Sandeman Ruby Port is crafted in the traditional Porto Wine method with emphasis on making it a rich and robust wine with a depth of flavour and finesse. This is achieved by carefully blending multiples wines from Sandeman’s large stockholding.

name: The Glenlivet 25 Year Old
notes: The Glenlivet 25 Year Old is made from the rarest whiskies aged for minimum of at leat 25 years. The single malt is batch produced and finished in ex sherry casks.

name: Black by Bacardi
notes: The Black by Bacardi is a classic dark rum blended with aged rum to ensure a smooth taste coupled with a bold flavour.This rum is manufactured in Sri Lanka by International Distilleries Limited under the license of Bacardi.

name: The Glenlivet 21 Year Old
notes: The Glenlivet 21 Year Old is a meticulously crafted whisky. Aged for 21 years in hand picked American Oak and ex-sherry cask, this single malt has a distinct flavour of dried fruits with a rich, vibrant intensity and long finish.

name: The Chocolate Block Fine Wine
notes: Made by Boekenhoutskloof – South Africa’s Winery of the Year 2020, the Chocolate Block Fine Wine is a cult favourite. The winemaker Marc Kent slightly tweaks the blend with every vintage has its unique flavour profile.

name: William Lawsons Blended Scotch, 1 Litre
notes: William Lawsons is the sixth best selling Scotch whisky in the world. The classic Scotch whisky is medium bodied and sweet.

name: Chivas Regal Ultis
notes: The Chivas Regal Ultis captures 200 years of blending expertise of Chivas Brothers. Crafted by Master Blender, Sandy Hyslop to honour the previous five Master Blenders who played instrumental roles in the history of Chivas.

name: Glenmorangie Original 12 Year Old
notes: Glenmorangie’s iconic Highland single malt is now even more delicious, with 12 years of maturation bringing added richness and depth. Bright gold in colour, it opens with fresh citrus and ripening peaches, beautifully balanced by Glenmorangie’s signature creamy vanilla softness.

name: Gift Box
notes: If you are looking to gift someone a bottle – but don’t want to go through the hassle of wrapping it up – this amazing Gift box is the perfect choice you. The high quality black hardboard box is crafted to perfection by artisans in Sri Lanka using waste from paddy, banana and pineapple cultivations as well as waste paper and elephant dung.

name: Campo Viejo Rioja Tempranillo
notes: The Campo Viejo Rioja Tempranillo is made exclusively with Tempranillo grapes and a passionate winemaking philosophy. The wine has intense aromas of ripe red fruit followed by woody notes with hints of vanilla and other sweet spices.

name: Piccini Rosso Toscana IGT
notes: The Piccini Rosso Toscana is a harmonius, velvetty wine with flavours of chocolate and licorice and perfect acidic balance. Aromas of ripe cherries, plums, red berries and hints of spices can be noticed when swirled in a wine glass.

name: Piccini Venetian Dress Prosecco Rosé
notes: The Piccini Sparkling Prosecco Rosé is made from a blend of glera and pinot noir grape varieties. On the nose, the wine Rosa has aromas of red berries, and white flowers.

name: Piccini Venetian Dress Prosecco
notes: The Piccini Prosecco has intense fruity aromas of lemon, grapefruit, and apple with hints of floral notes. On the palate – the citrus notes contrast the aromas making it a fresh and fine sparkling wine.

name: Angostura Bitters
notes: The essential ingredient in any cocktail bar – the Angostura Bitters adds a layer of complexity and enhances the flavour profile of any cocktail. The Angostura Aromatic Bitters helps cleanse the palate and also aids in digestion.

name: Beehive Brandy VSOP, 1 Litre
notes: The Beehive Brandy VSOP is an award winning blend of brandies ages in oak casks with a hint of armagnac. Rich Amber hue in colour, the brandy has aromas of wooden vanilla notes with hints of pear.

name: Saint Louis VSOP Brandy, 700ml
notes: Saint Louis VSOP Brandy is double distilled and aged in oak barrels for 5 years. Dark amber in colour, the brandy has aromas of citrus and orange notes with hints of nuts and cloves.

name: Atto Primo Sparkling Brut
notes: The Atto Primo Sparkling Brut is an everyday sparkling wine.?Straw green colour with greenish hints, the sparkling wine is lightly fruity, fresh and intense in flavours and aromas.

name: Jack Daniels 500ml – Pack of 10 Miniatures
notes: The Jack Daniels you know and love, now in a fun size – The Jack Daniels miniature and in a 10 Pack! Jack Daniel’s Black Label (also known as Old No. 7 or more commonly as JD or simply Jack) is one of the best selling whiskeys in the world.

name: Bushmills Original
notes: The Bushmills Original is a classic Irish Blend. Grain whiskey is aged for a minimum of five years before combining with the single malt whiskey.

name: Blue Nun Sparkling Gold 24K
notes: The Blue Nun 24K Gold Edition is made using real gold flakes. With a touch of delicious fruitiness, this German Sparkling Wine is elegant and light.

name: Johnnie Walker Black Label, 4.5 Litres
notes: Recognized as the benchmark for all other deluxe blends, Johnnie Walker Black Label is a true icon. Created using only whiskies aged for a minimum of 12 years from the four corners of Scotland, Johnnie Walker Black Label has an unmistakably smooth, deep character.

name: A Nos Amours Demi Sec
notes: Pale yellow in colour, the A Nos Amours Demi Sec hails from the South Western region of France. Pale Yellow in colour, the sparkling wine has aromas of green apple and pear.

name: Gossips Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Made with grapes from select vineyards in South East Australia, the Gossips Cabernet Sauvignon has aromas of fresh blackcurrants and earthly aromas. On the palate, this wine has flavours of berry and wood with subtle layers of chocolate mint.

name: Patron Silver Tequila
notes: The Patron Silver Tequila is an ultra premium tequila. Handcrafted from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave and carefully distilled in small batches.

name: Amarula Cream
notes: The Amarula Cream is made from the ripe Marula fruit of the of Marula tree. The tree is native to the sunny and frost free sub-Equatorial African region.

name: Jack Daniels Gold No 27
notes: The Jack Daniel’s No 27 Gold is exceptionally smooth as it is twice charcoal mellowed. The whiskey is also matured in golden hued maple barrels for a rich, warm finish.

name: Jack Daniels Tennessee Rye, 1 Litre
notes: Jack Daniels Tennessee Rye is made with 70 percent rye grain, natural spring water, and the reputed charcoal mellowing process of the Jack Daniels distillery. The whiskey has is a smooth whiskry with peppery flavours crackling with rye spice.

name: Sipsmith Sloe Gin
notes: The Sipsmith Sloe Gin is made by distilling the London Dry Gin in copper pot stills and leaving it to rest on wild sloe berries. This makes for a handmade sloe gin that bursts of flavour.

name: Drambuie
notes: Drambuie is a blend of aged Scotch Whisky, rare Scottish heather honey and aromatic herbs and spices. Best served in cocktails or in desserts.

name: Tullamore DEW
notes: The Tullamore DEW is the original triple blended Irish Whisky with a reputation for its smooth and gentle complexity. This Irish whisky is made from three spirits – grain whiskey, malt whiskey, and pot still whiskey.

name: Remy Martin VSOP
notes: The Remy Martin VSOP stands as a symbol of the expertise of the cognac making house founded in 1724. The champagne fine cognac has intense aromas of vanilla due to the aging in French Limousine oak barrels coupled with notes of baked apple, floral notes, and ripe apricot.

name: Moet and Chandon Imperial Brut Magnum, 1.5 Litres
notes: A champagne that need no introduction, the Mo?t & Chandon Imperial Brut Champagne embodies unique style, distinguished fruitness, and elegant maturity. Synonymous with celebrations and achievements, the champagne has intense notes of green apple and citrus fruits.

name: Belvedere Pure, 1.75 Litres
notes: Crafted with 600 years of Polish vodka making tradition, the Belvedere Vodka is the epitome of luxury vodka. Made with 100% Polish Dankowskie Rye and 0% additives including sugar or glycerine, this vodka is completely natural.

name: Laphroaig 10 Year Old
notes: Aged for a decade, the Laphroaig 10 Year Old is distilled by master distillers following traditions laid down for over 200 years. The single malt is a classic Islay Scotch, made from malted barley, cold-smoked, and then dried over peat fire.

name: Grey Goose Original Vodka, 1.75 Litres
notes: Grey Goose Original Vodka, made from the finest French winter wheat and pure spring water from the Cognac region of France, is a vodka unlike any other. The vodka has a floral and delicate nose with a sweet and round palate.

name: Remy Martin XO
notes: Made from a blend of more than 400 eaux-da-vie, the Remy Martin XO Cognac is the signature Cognac in the Remy Martin range. The expert blending of the Cellar Master allows the drinker to enjoy the full aromatic complexity of the Cognac Fine Champagne.

name: Blue Nun Merlot
notes: The Blue Nun Merlot is a full bodied smooth red wine with aromatic notes of spicy plum, and blackcurrant. On the palate, the wine has intense red fruit flavours.

name: Antica Sambuca Classic
notes: The Antica Sambuca Classic combines outstanding ingredients and meticulous artisanal productiion process. The key ingredient is star anise and a combination fo 17 herbs and spices, alcohol, water, and sugar.

name: St Remy XO
notes: St Remy XO is a rich and complex brandy that remains true to the style of French brandy making. Luminous amber colour in appearance.

name: Aberlour 12 Year Old
notes: Softened by double cask maturation, the Aberlour 12 Year Old portrays the crisp, citrus character of Aberlour. The spirit is mellowed in both traditional oak and seasoned sherry casks to deliver a balanced flavour profile.

name: The Singleton of Dufftown 18 Year Old
notes: The Singleton of Dufftown 18 Year Old is enginerred to be a perfectly balanced, smooth, yet rich Single Malt Scotch whisky. The medium to light bodied whisky has an attractive deep amber coloured look.

name: Jameson Caskmates Stout Edition
notes: The Jameson Caskmates Stout Edition is a truly wonderful creation – Triple distilled Irish whisky patiently finished in Irish Craft Beer seasoned barrels. The whisky has aromas of fresh cut hay coupled with a fruity character – pears, and green apple with a dash of lime zest.

name: Havana Club 7 Year Old Dark Rum
notes: The Havana Club 7 Years was described by its creator as “The very essence of Cuban Rum”. Made to be enjoyed on the rocks or in cocktails – the Havana Club 7 Years is a highly versatile dark rum.

name: Beefeater 24 London Dry Gin
notes: The Beefeater 24 gets its name as 12 exotic botanicals are steeped for 24 hours in London, the gin capital of the world. The gin is inspired by the refined and exhilirating aspects of modern day London.

name: Martell VSOP
notes: The Martell VSOP is a cognac that is unquely aged in red oak barrels. These hand selected barrels are crafted from fine grained oak, and have previously been used to age eaux-de-vie before being chosen to mature the Martell VSOP.

name: Oban 14 Year Old
notes: The Oban 14 Year Old is distilled in one of the smallest pot stills in Scotland. Olive Gold in colour, this single malt Scotch has immediate and confident aromas of ripe orchard fruits, fruit cake, and hints of nuts.

name: Don Julio Blanco Tequila
notes: The Don Julio Blanco Tequila is tequila in its truest form. This luxury premium tequila exclusively uses 100% blue weber agave plants and time honourned distillation methods.

name: William Lawsons Blended Scotch
notes: William Lawsons is the sixth best selling Scotch whisky in the world. The classic Scotch whisky is medium bodied and sweet.

name: Martini Fiero
notes: The Martini Fiero is made to be mixed with tonic. This vermouth is a blend of citrus, bittersweet orange, and crisp white wines – making it a perfect drink when combined with tonic.

name: Aberfeldy 12 Year Old
notes: The Aberfeldy 12 Year Old is a Single Malt Scotch that is mellowed for 12 years in handmade oak casks. This unconventional single malt is a smooth, sweet dram that stands apart from the commonly available single malts.

name: Dewars 15 Year Old
notes: The Dewars 15 Year Old is crafted using a double aeging process where the whisky is aged after blending. This process coupled wuth the golden water source brings about a sweeter, lighter blended Scotch Whisky that is unusually smooth.

name: Patron XO Cafe Liqueur
notes: The Patron XO Cafe is a dark delicious blend that combines the Patron Tequila with the natural esseence of Arabica coffee. Dark, rich brown in colour, the Patron XO Cafe has aromas of fresh coffee, chocolate, and vanilla.

name: McGuigan Black Label Merlot
notes: The McGuigan Black Label Merlot is an smooth, flavoursome wine with ripe characters of cherrys, plums, and raspberries. Subtle but discernable notes of oak and vanilla can also be seen with the wine.

name: Kraemer Demi Sec
notes: Pale yellow in colour, the Kraemer Demi Sec is a fine French sparkling wine with an abundunce of bubbles. Greenish yellow hue in colour, this elegant sparkling wine has a brioche bouquet.

name: Hankey Bannister 12 Year Old
notes: The Hankey Bannister 12 Year Old is aged for 12 years in American ex-Bourbon casks giving it the golden amber colour. The whisky has sweet aromas with hints of oak and vanilla.

name: Heineken, 500ml Can
notes: From its origins as a 19th-century local beer, brewed in Amsterdam, Heineken has transformed over the years into a global icon that is sold in 192 countries and is the world’s most international premium beer brand known for its superior taste and unique brewing style. Today, Heineken stands as a hallmark for quality and relies on the same successful recipe and principles that were developed by its founder; Gerard Adriaan Heineken, almost 150 years ago.

name: Heineken, 330ml Sleek Can
notes: From its origins as a 19th-century local beer, brewed in Amsterdam, Heineken has transformed over the years into a global icon that is sold in more than 192 countries and is the world’s most international premium beer brand known for its superior taste and unique brewing style. Today, Heineken stands as a hallmark for quality and relies on the same successful recipe and principles that were developed by its founder; Gerard Adriaan Heineken, almost 150 years ago.

name: Heineken, 330ml Bottle
notes: From its origins as a 19th-century local beer, brewed in Amsterdam, Heineken has transformed over the years into a global icon that is sold in more than 192 countries and is the world’s most international premium beer brand known for its superior taste and unique brewing style. Today, Heineken stands as a hallmark for quality and relies on the same successful recipe and principles that were developed by its founder; Gerard Adriaan Heineken, almost 192 years ago.

name: Grants Triple Wood
notes: While many whiskies gain their flavour from one cask, the Grants Triple Wood (formerly Grants Family Reserve) gets its distinct aroma and flavour from three different casks. Cask 1 – The Virgin Oak Casks that gives its spicy robustness Cask 2 – The American Oak Casks that provides the smoothness Cask 3 – The Bourbon Casks that offers the sweetness.

name: Johnnie Walker Aged 18 Year Old
notes: The Johnnie Walker Aged 18 Year Old is a rich and indulgent blended Scotch that perfectly balances sweet fruit, creamy smoothiness, and warm spice. Aged for 18 long years, the whisky is filled with layers of flavour and aromas.

name: Volare Blue Curacao
notes: Volare Blue Curacao is probably the most famous in the Volare range. The oranges of the Curacao island form the base of this liqueur.

name: Four Pillars Rare Dry Gin
notes: The Four Pillars Rare Dry Gin is the original and classic Four Pillars Gin. The gin is a truly international gin as it combines – Asian botanicals, Mediterranean citrus, and Australian gin making.

name: Talisker 18 Year Old
notes: The Talisker 18 Year Old is produced by the sea in the oldest distillery in the Isle of Skye. The Talisker 18 is an award winning single malt.

name: Santa Helena Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Santa Helena Sauvignon Blanc has a pale yellow hue with green highlights. The wine has aromas of fresh tropical fruits such as mango, grapefruit, and pineapple.

name: McGuigan Black Label Chardonnay
notes: The McGuigan Black Label Chardonnay is smooth wine with a creamy palate. The wine has aromas and tastes of sweet tropical fruit and melon flavours with subtle notes of vanilla.

name: Jack Daniels Tennessee Fire
notes: Jack Daniels Tennessee Fire blends together the original Jack Daniels No 7, with a unique fiery cinnamon liqueur resulting in a classic spirit with a smooth finish. The whisky delivers a bold character of the No 7 coupled with a warm, smooth finish of cinnamon.

name: Cockburns Special Reserve Port
notes: The Cockburns Special Reserve Port as first created in 1969. Made to bridge the gap between vintage and younger ports – the Cockburns Special Reserve Port created a new category.

name: McGuigan Black Label Red
notes: The McGuigan Black Label Red is an approachable and classic red blend. Aromas and flavours of ripe red fruits such as spicy plum, blackberry, and cherry rush in with a perfect balance of tannins.

name: Spice Island Pinotage
notes: The Spice Island Pinotage is a fruity red wine black cherry flavours, cedar, mocha, and subtle notes of spice.

name: Volare Grenadine Syrup
notes: Extracts and juices of red fruits such as raspberries, strawberries, and pomegranates make up the the Volare Grenadine Syrup. Perfect for cocktails such as Tequila Sunrise or Cosmopolitan.

name: Volare Triple Sec
notes: Made from an infusion and distillation of sweet orange peels, the Volare Triple Sec is a classic cocktail. Fragrant on the nose with citrus aromas, the Triple Sec is sweet in taste.

name: Lagavulin 16 Year Old
notes: The Lagavulin 16 Year Old is known by experts and connoisseurs as the “King of the Islay”. This essential single malt Scotch is a must have in any whisky enthusiasts collection.

name: Moet and Chandon Ice Imperial
notes: The Moet and Chandon Ice Imperial is the first and only champagne created to be enjoyed over ice. The champagne is made with a blend of Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, and Chardonnay grape varietals.

name: Cockburns Fine Tawny Port
notes: The Cockburns Fine Tawny Port is known for its caramel nuttiness and easy going nature. This vibrant wine is matured for upto three years in oak casks.

name: Cockburns Fine Ruby Port
notes: The Cockburns Fine Ruby Port is a bright and fruity port wine that mixes easily or stands on its own. The wine is aged for two to three years in oak casks.

name: Valdivieso Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Valdivieso Sauvignon Blanc is crisp and aromatic white wine from the Central Valley region of Chile. Pale yellow with green hues in colour, the wine is loaded with aromas of citrus and tropical fruits with subtle herbaceous notes.

name: Hennessy XO
notes: The Hennessy XO Cognac was first created in 1870 by Maurice Hennessy for his circle of friends. The extra old (XO) cognac that becomes Hennessy XO is aged for a minimum of 10 years in French Oak barrels.

name: Crystal Head Vodka Miniature
notes: The Crystal Head Vodka is a result of four distillations of locally sourced Canadian corn. This is then filtered seven times including three filterations through layers of semi precious Herkimer diamond crystals.

name: The Glenlivet 18 Year Old
notes: The Glenlivet 18 Year Old single malt combines tropical fruitiness and spicy complexity. This is the result of a combination of various cask types – first and second fill American Oak and Ex-Sherry Oak casks.

name: Glenfiddich Excellence 26 Year Old
notes: The Glenfiddich Excellence 26 Year Old, created to celebrate the family ownership of Glenfiddich since 1887. The rare and aged single malt Scotch whisky spent 26 years maturing in America Oak ex-bourbon casks.

name: Glenfiddich 21 Year Old
notes: Patiently matured, the Glenfiddich 21 Year Old is a traditional Speyside Scotch whisky with Glenfiddich signature notes. This single malt whisky finishes its maturation in Caribbean rum casks.

name: Glenfiddich 18 Year Old
notes: The Glenfiddich 18 Year Old is matured in fine Olorosso Sherry Casks and American Oak Casks. This beings about an incredibly fruity and and oaky whisky.

name: Hennessy VSOP Privilege
notes: The Hennessy VSOP Privilege is a balanced cognac which expresses 200 years of Hennessy’s Cognac making expertise. Mahogany in colour, the Cognac releases mature fruit aromas that settle to bring out the harmony of this cognac.

name: Hayman’s London Dry Gin
notes: The Hayman’s London Dry Gin is made using 150 year old family recipes. This gin has a two day manufacturing process.

name: Sipsmith London Dry Gin
notes: The Sipsmith London Dry Gin will be familiar to the eighteenth century Master Distiller. Handcrafted combined with traditional copper pot distillation in the city of London.

name: Glenfiddich IPA Experiment
notes: The Glenfiddich IPA Experiment is first in the Glenfiddich Experimental Series. This experiment proved that traditional whisky casks can be enhanced in a pioneering way.

name: Glenfiddich Project XX
notes: Crafted by 20 exceptionally brilliant minds in the whisky industry, the Glenfiddich Project XX is part of the Experimental Series. This whisky was shrouded in secrecy to the extent that the experts working on the project didn?t know about the specifics until halfway through the project.

name: El Jimador Reposado
notes: The El Jimador Reposado Tequila is a 100% blue weber agave Tequila. The golden colour is a result of a two month maturation in handmade American Oak Barrels.

name: Cardhu 15 Year Old
notes: The Cardhu 15 Year Old is a delightful and silky whisky from the speyside with layers of toffee and and fruits. Deep old gold in appearance, this whisky has aromas of rich fruit and complex spice notes.

name: Caol Ila 12 Year Old
notes: The Caol Ila 12 Year Old is the ultimate Islay Malt. Considered by experts as the best entry to peaty malt whiskies, the Caol Ila does not disappoint.

name: Glenkinchie 12 Year Old
notes: The Glenkinchie 12 Year Old is a fragrant and light whisky with an appetizing taste. Bright gold in colour, this whisky has an aromatic nose with discernable notes of vanilla, freshy cut flowers, and toasty notes.

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin
notes: The Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin perfectly combines gin making traditions of England, spices of India, and the landscape of the Black Forest in Germany where it originates. 47 handpicked ingredients and soft spring water from the Black Forest are distilled nd matured in earthern containers.

name: The Glenlivet 15 Year Old
notes: The Glenlivet 15 Year Old has an intense deep golden hue with a distinct character that can be attributed to the unique process of selective maturation where part of the spirit is matured in French Oak casks. This whisky has creamy, rich, and buttery aromas with flavours of sweet fruits and delicate spices on the palate.

name: The Singleton of Dufftown, 15 Year Old
notes: The 15 Year Old expression from The Singleton of Dufftown is inspired by passion to create the perfectly balanced, smooth, yet rich whisky. Deep amber in colour, the whisky has a drying and slightly spicy feel on the nose coupled with toffeeapple aromas.

name: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old, 375ml
notes: Smooth, rich, and generous are the perfect three words to describe a Chivas. Comprised with malt and grain whiskies which have been aged for a minimum of 12 years, the whisky has notes of vanilla, ripe apple, and honey.

name: Bacardi Carta Oro Gold Rum
notes: First produced in 1862, the Bacardi Carta Oro is named after the Spanish word for gold – Oro. The rum is a blend of 14 different rums aged between one to two years.

name: Bacardi Limon Rum
notes: Despite being named after the Spanish word for lemon, the Bacardi Limon rum gets its citrus flavours from three fruits – lemon, lime, and grapefruit. This citrus infused white rum combines the smoothness of Bacardi with intense citrus fruits.

name: Albert Bichot Mâcon Villages Blanc
notes: The Albert Bichot M?con Villages Blanc hails from the region of Southern Burgundy where the climate is less harsh. Made from 100% Chardonnay grapes, Albert Bichot M?con Villages Blanc has floral aromas of acacia and honeysuckle with hints of mineral.

name: Cape Dreams Pinotage Rosé
notes: A refreshing wine with a beautiful colour, the Cape Dreams Pinotage Ros? has a floral bouquet on the nose with flavours of berry and red cherry on the palate. Pairs well with light meals, soups, prawn curry, and salads.

name: Cape Dreams Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Matured in new French wood, the Cape Dreams Cabernet Sauvignon is deep garnet in colour. The wine has of berry flavours and aromas with subtle hints of vanilla.

name: Cape Dreams Sauvignon Blanc
