notes: The Cape Dreams Sauvignon Blanc is an elegant white wine brimming with aromas of gooseberry, green fig, and melon. On the palate, the wine is packed with tropical flavours such as passion fruit.

name: Passion Pop Original
notes: The Original Passion Pop with its pale straw colour has intoxicating aromas of passion fruit and citrus. On the palate, the wine harmoniously flows with sweet passion fruit flavours and a crisp bubbly finish.

name: Los Cardos Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The Los Cardos Sauvignon Blanc is greenish yellow in colour with intense and enticing aromas of lime, grapefruit, white peach, and passion fruit. On the palate, the Los Cardos Sauvignon Blanc is a lively wine that is fresh and well balanced.

name: Los Cardos Malbec
notes: Deep violet in colour, the Los Cardos Malbec has sweet, intense, spicy aromas with notes of red fruits and floral hints such as violets. On the palate, the Malbec is well balanced, soft, fresh and velvetty.

name: Taittinger Brut Reserve
notes: Combining Chardonnay (40%), Pinot Meunier and Pinot Noir (60%) from over 35 vineyards, the Taittinger Brut Reserve is matured to perfection. Unique among fine non-vintage champagnes, the Taittinger Brut Reserve has a high proportion of Chardonnay grapes and is aged for a minimum of three years in cellars.

name: Agavita Blanco Tequila
notes: The Agavita Blanco Tequila is a clear tequila which gets its sweetness from the flavours of agave. This tequila has earthy aromas coupled with flavours of menthol, pepper, and minty freshness.

name: Hankey Bannister Original
notes: For over 250 years, Hankey Bannister has hand selected and blended fine and rare Scotch whiskies to create a smooth, light, and well balanced whisky. Golden toffe hue in colour, the Hankey Bannister has slight spicy aromas portraying an extra depth.

name: Speyburn Single Malt 10 Year Old
notes: The Speyburn 10 Year Old is a single malt with bold flavours. The whisky is matured in a comination of American Oak ex-bourbon casks and ex-Sherry casks.

name: Old Pulteney Single Malt 12 Year Old
notes: Crafted in traditional methods that have been long abandoned by other distillers, the Old Pulteney 12 Year Old has won numerous awards in the international scene. The whisky is matured in hand selected, air dried ex-bourbon casks to create a unique 12 year expression.

name: El Jimador Blanco
notes: Made from 100% hand-harvested blue Weber agave tequila, and then double distilled to achieve perfection in clarity, the El Jimador Blanco tequila is a tequila in its own league. The El Jimador Blanco has fresh citrus aromas coupled with fruity and spicy flavours with balanced herbaceous notes.

name: Martini Extra Dry
notes: The Martini Extra Dry combines sun dried Florentine iris roots, herbs, citrus, and raspberry extracts making it the epitome of Italian winemaking. Best served with ice, over a slice of lemon.

name: Martini Bianco
notes: With Vanilla flowers at the heart of Martini Bianco, it is a blend of herbs and sweet floral spices. Softer, lighter, and delicate in style, the Martini Bianco represents the highest quality of Italian winemaking.

name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label
notes: Made from grapes of 50 to 60 different vineyards, the Veuve Cliquot Yellow Label is a champagne with a bright personality. The Champagne manages to achieve a perfect balance between two opposing factors – silkiness and strength.

name: Moet and Chandon Rosé Imperial Brut
notes: The Moet and Chandon Ros? Imperial is a radiant, expressive and spontaneous expression of Moet and Chandon.The champagne has a glowing pink hue with amber highlights with bewitching aromas of red fruits such as cherry, wild strawberry, and raspberry with hints of rose and pepper. The wine has an expressive palate with intense berry flavours, and fleshiness and firmness of peach.

name: Gekkikan Traditional Sake, 1.8 Litres
notes: Representing over 370 years and 14 geneerations of sake brewing experience, the Gekkeikan Traditional Sake is the worlds most popular sake. The sake is served in the Imperial household since 1900.

name: Four Pillars Bloody Shiraz Gin
notes: The Four Pillars Bloody Shiraz Gin combines the best of Yarra Valley Grapes steeped into the Four Pillars Gin. The cool climate Shiraz grapes offers the perfect balance of sweet fruit combined with the goodness of the Four Pillars Gin.

name: Jacobs Creek Le Petit Rose
notes: The Jacobs Creek La Petit Rose is made from Pinot Noir, Grenache, and Mataro and is reflective of modern Australian winemaking. On the nose, the ros? has notes of red currant and spice.

name: Tanqueray No 10, 1 Litre
notes: Named after the experimental “Tiny Ten” still that the gin was created in 2000, the Tanquray No 10 is made in small batches. The gin combines 8 botanicals by adding chamomile flowers, orange, lime and grapefruit to the original Tanqueray formula which has Juniper, coriander, licorice and angelica root.

name: Glenfiddich 15 Year Old
notes: The Glenfiddich 15 Year Old is a testament of Glenfiddich’s tradition of innovation. The whisky is aged in European oak sherry casks and new oak casks which is then mellowed by the Solera Vat.

name: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old
notes: With a blend of 85 flavour notes in each drop, the Chivas Regal 18 Year Old is a complex yet refined Scotch Whisky. This award winning blended whisky uses a combination of grain and malt whiskies all across Scotland including the classic Speyside malt from Strathisla.

name: Jameson Black Barrel
notes: The Jameson Black Barrel is a triple distilled and twice charred Irish whiskey. This whiskey has aromas of intense aromas of butterscotch, fudge, and creamy toffee as a result of the time spent in maturing in barrels.

name: Absolut Lime
notes: The Absolut Lime is a premium lime flavoured vodka that captures the true essence of lime in a bottle. The vodka can be used in any classic cocktail to enhance the flavours and add a refreshing twist.

name: Absolut Mandrin
notes: When orange flavoured vodkas was all the hype, Absolut reimagined flavoured vodkas differently with the Absolut Mandrin vodka. Easy to mix.

name: Absolut Vanilla
notes: The Absolut Vanilla or the Absolut Vanilia is a magnificent vanilla flavoured vodka that can enhance anything that uses vanilla. Perfect for experimenting with contrasting flavours, or those with a sweet tooth.

name: Absolut Raspberri
notes: The Absolut Raspberri is a premium raspberry flavoured vodka with the character of riperned raspberries. This versatile vodka is easy to mix to make your favourite cocktail or tastes great when drunk neat.

name: Absolut Elyx
notes: Made from a wheat grown from a single estate in southern Sweden which has been growing wheat since 1400’s, the Absolut Elyx redefines luxury vodka. The vodka is made using a hand operated copper vintage column that has been in operation since 1921.

name: Jack Daniels Single Barrel Select
notes: The Jack Daniels Single Barrel Select is a Tennessee whiskey with a one-of-a-kind flavour. Bottled at 47% ABV, the whiskey has subtle notes of caramel and spice with fruit notes and sweet aromas.

name: Jack Daniels Gentleman Jack
notes: The Jack Daniels Gentleman Jack is an exceptionally smooth Tennessee Whiskey. The whiskey has an impressive character and flavour attributed to it ‘double mellowing’ as it it is filtered through charcoal before being filled in a cask and also before bottling.

name: Russian Standard Gold Vodka
notes: Inspired by an ancient recipe, the Russian Standard Gold is made from Russian winter wheat and the pristine glacial waters from Lake Lagoda. The vodka’s quadruple distillation through charcoal aims to achieve perfect smoothness.

name: Crystal Head Vodka
notes: The Crystal Head Vodka is a result of four distillations of locally sourced Canadian corn. This is then filtered seven times including three filterations through layers of semi precious Herkimer diamond crystals.

name: Penfolds Koonunga Hill Shiraz Cabernet
notes: The Penfolds Koonunga Hill Shiraz Cabernet is one of Australia’s favourite premium red wines. Made from 77% Shiraz and 23% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes.

name: Tall Horse Shiraz
notes: The Tall Horse Shiraz is a smooth and fruity wine. This South African wine has flavours and aromas of strawberry and blueberry coupled with slight peppery notes.

name: Tall Horse Merlot
notes: The Tall Horse Merlot is an easy drinking red wine. The wine has an intense nose of of ripe plum and spice.

name: Pimms No 1
notes: The Pimm’s No 1 Liqueur has a rich amber hue that comes from combining lots of gin with herbal botanicals, delicate spices, and caramelized orange. First created in 1840, in the Gin capital of the world – England, this liqueur is perfect for evenings.

name: Benediktiner Weissbier Dunkel 500ml Bottle
notes: The Benediktiner Weissbier Dunkel is a dark white beer brewed to the traditional Bavarian methods. The beer produces an intense aromas of dark honey and caramel coupled with aromas of chestnut, vermouth, and bitter sage.

name: Benediktiner Hell Lager 500ml Bottle
notes: The Benediktiner Hell Lager is a quintessential Bavarian Lager with a golden hue colour and malty sweetness that is balanced by a slight dryness. The Hell lager has gentle notes of hops, fruitiness and aromatic herbs.

name: Johnnie Walker Black Label Miniature
notes: Recognized as the benchmark for all other deluxe blends, Johnnie Walker Black Label is a true icon. Created using only whiskies aged for a minimum of 12 years from the four corners of Scotland, Johnnie Walker Black Label has an unmistakably smooth, deep character.

name: Malibu
notes: First lauched in 1978, the Malibu Caribbean Rum is made from Caribbean sugarcane and pure water and aged in oak barrels for two years. The rum rightfully gained a reputation for its sweet and refreshing taste.

name: Martini Rosso, 750ml
notes: Martini Rosso claims to be the world’s first vermouth. The bittersweet effect of the vermouth is a result of the 50+ herbs and spices used in production.

name: St Remy VSOP, 700ml
notes: A fine brandy with a well balanced, smooth taste and distinctive French brandy character. St-Remy uses eau-de-vie distilled from eight grape varieties, which are aged 1-2 years, of which 6 months are spent exclusively in small 200 litre oak barrels.

name: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
notes: The Johnnie Walker Blue Label combines only the rarest and exceptional old-aged malt and grain Scotch whiskies. Only one in a thousand casks goes into making this whisky.

name: BV Land Peach Schnapps
notes: The BV Land Peach Schnapps is made from the finest ingredients. Can be served as a shot, or on the rocks.

name: Jack Daniels Miniature
notes: The Jack Daniels you know and love, now in a fun size – The Jack Daniels miniature! Jack Daniel’s Black Label (also known as Old No. 7 or more commonly as JD or simply Jack) is one of the best selling whiskeys in the world.

name: Valdouro Ruby Port
notes: With a rich tawny red colour, the Valdouro Ruby Port has harmonious aromas of red fruits coupled with subtle notes of wood. On the palate, one can taste raspberry, cranberry, and strawberries with spice notes of caramel and toast.

name: Belvedere Pure
notes: Crafted with 600 years of Polish vodka making tradition, the Belvedere Vodka is the epitome of luxury vodka. Made with 100% Polish Dankowskie Rye and 0% additives including sugar or glycerine, this vodka is completely natural.

name: JP Chenet Cabernet Syrah
notes: Matured in stainless steel vats to preserve the richness of the wine, the JP Chenet Cabernet Syrah is an intensely fruity and well balanced. The clear, ruby red wine has aromas of cherry and red currant with subtle notes of chilli.

name: JP Chenet Sauvignon Blanc
notes: The JP Chenet Sauvignon Blanc is a distinct wine in a unique bottle. The wine contains perfectly mature grapes harvested at night which are pressed immediately.

name: Santa Helena Merlot
notes: The Santa Helena Merlot has intense aromas of blackberry and plum coupled with subtle spicy notes. Best paired with red meats such as lamb, pork and duck.

name: Valdouro Rosé Port
notes: Produced in the Duoro region of Portugal, the Vadouro Ros? Port portays a vibrant pink colour. The wine has a bouquet of red fruit aromas and palate filled with notes of raspberry, cherry, and gooseberry.

name: Valdouro Tawny Port
notes: Produced in the Duoro region of Portugal, the Vadouro Tawny Port is a rich, full bodied wine. This fortified wine has fruity and vanilla aromas with suble oak notes.

name: Blue Nun Riesling
notes: Created in 1951, Blue Nun combines European winemaking technology with German efficiency. The Blue Nun Riesling is a frangrant white wine with an acidic fruity character and residual sweetness.

name: Blue Nun Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Created in 1951, Blue Nun combines European winemaking technology with German efficiency. The Blue Nun Cabernet Sauvignon is a full bodies smooth red wine with spicy and fruity notes.

name: Mateus Rosé Original
notes: With a unique bottle and an appealing pink hue, the Mateus Rose is a fresh seductive wine. The ros? wine has an intense bouquet and flavours of young wines.

name: Angel Beach Vodka
notes: Triple filtered with charcoal to achieve its distinct smoothness, the Angel Vodka (also Angel Beach Vodka) is brewed locally to compete with the likes of other international brands.

name: Cointreau French Orange Liqueur
notes: With a recipe unchanged since 1875, the Cointreau contains only four ingredients – orange peels, sugar, water, and alcohol). Distilled in traditional methods with a unique blend of bitter and sweet orange peels, Cointreau is crafted as the perfect orange liqueur.

name: Brokers Gin
notes: Brokers Gin is made to a 200 year old recipe in a 200 year old distillery. Containing the same traditional ten botanicals and?quadruple distilled spirit made from English wheat since inception, the gin is outstandingly smooth.

name: Jacobs Creek Sparkling Rosé
notes: Crafted from select Pinot Noir and Chardonnay grapes, the Jacobs Creek Sparkling Rose has delicate berry characteristics accompanied by an attractive pink hue. The wine has aromas of fresh strawberry and red currant coupled with delicate citrus fruit notes coupled with flavours of red berry and citrus fruit flavours.

name: The Glenlivet 12 Year Old
notes: Made with the classic Glenlivet style – first matured in traditional oak and then in American Oak casks, the Glenlivet 12 Year Old has a distinct smoothness coupled with summery aromas. The whisky has a well balanced palate and strong notes of pineapple.

name: The Glenlivet Founders Reserve
notes: The Glenlivet Founders Reserve is crafted to emulate the first 1824 Glenlivet. Inspired by the distillation methods of the founder George Smith, the whisky is manufactured in copper stills designed by the founder himself.

name: Absolut Citron Vodka – Lemon
notes: Absolut Citron Vodka, made from 100% natural taste and no added sugar, is the best selling flavored vodka from the Absolut range. The smooth lemon-flavored vodka has a fresh and fruity lime and lemon finish with a dash of lemon peel making it the perfect ingredient in crafting cocktails such as the infamous Cosmopolitan.

name: Skyy Vodka
notes: Skyy Vodka, triple filtered after four distillations, was crafted with the aim of making the perfect martini. Made from high-quality grains, this superior vodka is perfect for cocktails or sipping.

name: Ciroc Red Berry Vodka, 1 Litre
notes: Infused with fresh blackberries, raspberries and other natural flavours, the Ciroc Red Berry vodka is distilled five times to ensure a high quality smooth tasting vodka drinking experience.

name: Ketel One Vodka
notes: Combining traditional distillation methods and modern techniques, the Ketel One Vodka is crafted to deliver a crisp vodka with a soft finish. Made from select European wheat, the Ketel One Vodka is the result of over 300 years of distilling experience.

name: Martini Prosecco Sparkling Wine
notes: Martini Prosecco Sparkling Wine comprises of Moscato Bianco grapes. It is a sweet sparkling wine with notes of peach and herbs.

name: Dewars 12 Year Old
notes: Aged for 12 Years, the Dewars 12 Year Old was introduced as the first premium product in the Dewars premium range. The whiskey has notes of citrus, dried fruit, and vanilla which combines to form a pleasant and smooth whisky.

name: Gossips Shiraz
notes: Made with grapes from select vineyards in South East Australia, the Gossips Shiraz has aromas of dark berries and chocolates coupled with a balanced fruit symphony on the palate. Slow-cooked lamb is the ideal food pair for this wine.

name: Cinzano Bianco Vermouth
notes: Best enjoyed as an aperitif or an in a cocktail, the Cinzano Bianco has a nose of fresh flowers, and white peach coupled with herbaceous hints. The vermouth has flavors of vanilla, cinnamon, and hints of fruits.

name: Cinzano Rosso Sweet Vermouth
notes: Cinzano Rosso Sweet Vermouth combines quality and prestige. It has a rich infusion of herbs and spices of black cherry and vanilla with subtle hints of caramel.

name: Camino Real Gold Tequila
notes: The agaves used in making Camino Real grow in fields at 2,000 meters above sea level, hence the name Camino, i.e. ?high? in Spanish.

name: Martini Asti Spumante
notes: Comprising of Moscato Bianco grapes, the Martini Asti Spumante is a sweet sparkling wine with notes of peach and herbs such as sage coupled with fruity flavors of pineapple and pear. The D.O.G.C designation mention indicates the highest quality of Italian Wines.

name: Bombay Sapphire Gin
notes: Containing 10 hand-selected botanicals from the four corners of the world, Bombay Sapphire in its distinct blue bottle has notes of juniper with hints of pepper coupled with flavours of fresh herbs and subtle sweetness.

name: Grey Goose Original Vodka, 750ml
notes: Grey Goose Original Vodka, made from the finest French winter wheat and pure spring water from the Cognac region of France, is a vodka unlike any other. The vodka has a floral and delicate nose with a sweet and round palate.

name: Dewars White Label Whisky
notes: First crafted in 1899 and blended with 40 different scotch whiskies, the Dewar’s White Label has a uniquely refreshing taste that makes it a perfect accompaniment to food. With notes of honey, peach, and citrus – the whisky has a unique smoothness.

name: Jim Beam 4 Year Old
notes: With 225 years and seven generations of experience in crafting bourbons, the Jim Beam is the best selling bourbon in the world. Aged for four years in charred oak barrels, twice as long as required by regulation to be called a bourbon, Jim Beam Bourbon has a medium body and a beautiful caramel color.

name: Bickford & Sons Ginger Ale
notes: Made with Natural Ginger Essence, the Bickford and Sons Ginger Ale has unique flavours that complement the drink but don?t overpower the spirit.

name: Bickford & Sons Indian Tonic Water
notes: The Bickford & Sons Indian Tonic Water has a natural taste of Cinchona Extract and Quinine ensuring a smooth, floral finish.

name: Bickford & Sons Soda Water
notes: Purified carbonated Australian water: the Bickford & Sons Soda Water is a perfect high quality mixer for your spirits.

name: May Non Alcoholic Red Sparkling Grape
notes: Made with 100% high quality red grapes, the MAY Non Alcoholic Red Grape Juice contains no preservatives and no added sugar.

name: May Non Alcoholic White Sparkling Grape
notes: Made with 100% high quality white grapes, the MAY Non Alcoholic White Grape Juice contains no preservatives and no added sugar.

name: Famillie Perrin Côtes-du-Rhône Reserve Rouge
notes: Made from Grenache, Syrah and Mourvedre grapes the Famillie Perrin C?tes-du-Rh?ne Reserve Rouge has aromatic complexity coupled with a hints of blackcurrant making it an elegant wine.

name: Valdivieso Rosé
notes: Valdivieso Ros? with a gorgeous pink colour?has sweet aromas of ripe red fruits such as raspberries and strawberries.

name: Jacobs Creek Shiraz Rosé
notes: With aromas of fresh strawberries and raspberries enhanced by subtle spice notes, the Jacobs Creek Shiraz Ros? is a refreshing modern ros?.

name: McGuigan Black Label Shiraz
notes: The timeless classic Australian McGuigan Black Label Shiraz is a well rounded wine encapsulating rich flavours such as blackberry jam, ripe plums and a dash of spices.

name: Familia Torres Vina Esmeralda
notes: Aromatic and delicate wine from the Catalonia region of Spain, the Familia Torres Vina Esmeralda wine was created to be a fruitier wine.

name: Spice Island Chenin Blanc
notes: The Spice Island Chenin Blanc has intense flavours of pineapple and mango on the palate. Subtle hints of vanilla and butterscoth notes can be seen perfectly complementing each other.

name: Jam Jar Sweet White
notes: The Jam Jar Sweet White is packed with apricot and peach flavours. This easy to drink Moscato is a favourite for gatherings.

name: Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc
notes: Hailing from the Marlborough region of New Zealand, the Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc has a zesty finish with flavours of passion fruit, bright citrus and gooseberry.

name: Danzante Pinot Grigio
notes: Hand selected in September and gently pressed to contain the fruity and citrus notes the Danzante Pinot Grigio posseses crisp qualities of green apple and the sweetness of apricots.

name: Santa Helena Chardonnay
notes: A clean pale yellow wine with tropical aromas of banana, pineapple, and peach combined with sweet vanilla notes.

name: Jacobs Creek Chardonnay
notes: Unleashing a mix of melon and citrus aromas, the Jacob’s Creek Chardonnay is a well rounded wine with lively fruity flavours.

name: Gossips Sauvignon Blanc
notes: Number one our list for a value for money Sauvignon Blanc, the Gossips Sauvignon Blanc has fantastic aromas and tastes of tropical fruits such as gooseberry and passionfruit.

name: Gossips Pink Moscato
notes: With the perfect amount of sweetness on the palate coupled with notes of strawberries and cherries, the Gossips Sweet Lips Pink Moscato also has an inviting aroma of fresh strawberries. A perfect moscato to begin your evening.

name: McGuigan Black Label Moscato
notes: Discernable notes of honeydew melon, apricot, and floral notes make up the Moscato from the McGuigan Black Label Range.

name: Jam Jar Sweet Shiraz
notes: With aromas and flavors of ripe, juicy berries with dark chocolate undertones, the Jam Jar Sweet Shiraz is far more fun than your typical Shiraz. The perfect balance between sweetness and acidity makes for a refreshing approachability.

name: Culemborg Sweet Red
notes: The Culemborg Sweet Red is succulently sweet and smooth red blend has a rich textured ripe plum, blackcurrant fruit and winter spice flavours on the palate.

name: Oyster Bay Pinot Noir
notes: With romantic cherry, bright red berries and juicy black plum with a smooth and seductive texture, the Oyster Bay Pinot Noir is an elegant Pinot Noir enjoyed by wine lovers in the world.

name: Ruffino Chianti DOCG
notes: Ruffino Chianti combines Sangiovese with Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine carries fruity plum and intense cherry flavours, accompanied by hints of spice, hazelnut, and delicate violet aromas.

name: Ducato Montepulciano D’ Abruzzo DOC
notes: With a palate of blackberry and plums, the Ducato Montepulciano D’ Abruzzo DOC is a classic Italian wine. With a deep brilliant red colour, this wine will not fail in making a great acoompaniment to your meal.

name: Ducato Chianti DOCG
notes: Ducato Chianti DOGC has a fresh taste imposing a smooth and velvet taste at the same time. The wine?has an intense fresh ruby red colour coupled with aromas of fruits and flowers.

name: Bottega Valpolicella Classico DOC
notes: Bottega Valpolicella Classico DOC is a young, fresh and fragrant red wine. Made exclusively with handpicked grapes, this wine has flavours and aromas of delicate fruits and fine cherry notes.

name: Marquis de Beau Rond Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Marquis de Beau Rond Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold wine with notes of red fruit such as strawberry and cranberry. Perfect to complement a late evening meal.

name: Santa Helena Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Santa Helena Cabernet Sauvignon has a beautiful dark red ruby colour. The intense flavours and aromatic notes of cherry and blackcurrant perfectly blends together with lighter chocolate and vanilla notes.

name: Cono Sur Tocornal Merlot
notes: Cono Sur Tocornal Merlot has a dark and intense colour. The wine has aromas and taste of black fruits and soft hints of sweet toasted oak notes.

name: Cono Sur Tocornal Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: Cono Sur Tocornal Cabernet Sauvignon has an impressive rub red colour. With inviting notes of raspberry, plums and hints of sweet spices from Chile, this wine is perfect for an evening.

name: Valdivieso Merlot
notes: Intense flavours of red fruits such as plums with notes of coffee, chocholate, and spice coupled with smoky undertones, the Valdivieso Merlot is soft and smooth on the palate.

name: Gossips Merlot
notes: Gossips Merlot is a light red wine with aromas of red fruits coupled with notes of spice. On the palate, the flavours include plums and ripe raspberries with a tinge of liquorice.

name: Jacobs Creek Shiraz Cabernet
notes: Jacobs Creek Shiraz Cabernet is a blend of Shiraz grapes and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. The wine has flavours and aromas of red fruits including plum and dark cherry, and hints of mocha.

name: Jacobs Creek Merlot
notes: Jacobs Creek Merlot is classic Australian Merlot with a modern twist. The wine has intense blackberry and spicy and leafy notes with hints of spices.

name: McGuigan Black Label Cabernet Sauvignon
notes: McGuigan Black Label Cabernet Sauvignon has subtle aromatic hints of oak coupled with cinnamon and vanilla. One the palate, the Australian wine has stronger notes of dark cherry and blackberry.

name: Septima Malbec
notes: Septima Malbec is a neat ruby red wine. With aromas of plum and fig note, the wine also has subtle influence of vanilla caused by oak ageing.

name: J. Moreau & Fils Rose d’Anjou
notes: J. Moreau & Fils Rose d’Anjou is a careful blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Grolleau grapes.

name: Barefoot Pinot Grigio
notes: Barefoot Pinot Grigio has a crisp, bright finish. This white wine offers all the flavours of tart green apples with fresh, white peaches.

name: Barefoot Merlot
notes: Barefoot Merlot bursts with the all the rich flavours of juicy cherries, boysenberries, sweet plums, and smooth chocolate. This makes it a classic red wine with a bold personality.

name: Carlo Rossi California Red
notes: Carlo Rossi Smooth Red has fruity notes of perfectly ripe berries layered with hints of red fruit. The wine is perfect for pairing with dinner and company.

name: Carlo Rossi California Red, 1.5 Litres
notes: Carlo Rossi Smooth Red has fruity notes of perfectly ripe berries layered with hints of red fruit. The wine is perfect for pairing with dinner and company.

name: Gordons Premium Pink Distilled Gin
notes: Gordons Premium Pink Distilled Gin balances the refreshing taste of Gordons Gin and the sweetness of raspberries, strawberries, and redcurrant. This gin uses only natural fruit flavours to guarantee the highest quality real berry taste.

name: Jameson Irish Whiskey
notes: Jameson Irish Whiskey is blended with the finest Irish whiskies triple distilled to achieve exceptional smoothness. The whisky is stored in oak casks for four years.

name: Talisker, 10 Year Old
notes: Made by the sea on the Isle of Skye in the island’s oldest distillery, the Talisker 10 Year Old has enhanced flavours of fresh tangy peat and lots of spice. Brilliant Gold in colour, the Talisker 10 Year Old has powerful aromas of peat smoke with a hint of citrus sweetness.

name: Monkey Shoulder Blended Malt
notes: Looking for whiskey to make cocktails? Look no further as the Monkey Shoulder Blended Malt with its fruity aromas and mellow vanilla is perfect for mixing and crafting cocktails.

name: Vat 69, 375ml
notes: Vat 69 is a Blended Scotch Whisky with a light, very fresh, and slightly spicy taste profile.

name: Vat 69, 750ml
notes: Vat 69 is a Blended Scotch Whisky with a light, very fresh, and slightly spicy taste profile.

name: Famous Grouse
notes: With a blend of grain whiskies and single malts, the Famous Grouse is known for its sherry cask aging and commitment to quality. This easy to drink whiskey is best with a soda or in cocktails.

name: Ballantines Finest Whiskey
notes: Blended from more than 40 single malts and 4 single grain whiskies, Ballentines Finest has a nose that is soft, elegant, with heather honey aromas with a hint of spice. The whiskey has well balanced subtle nuances of milk chocolate, red apple and vanilla flavour taste.

name: J&B Rare
notes: The principal expression is J&B Rare, which is a light-colored and light-bodied whisky, ideal for mixing. Fresh, grassy, and nutty on the nose, J&B offers malt, spice, fruit salad, and sweet grains on a well-balanced palate.

name: The Singleton of Dufftown 12 Year Old
notes: The Singleton of Dufftown, 12 Year Old single malt whiskey is a naturally smooth and exceptionally balanced whisky. Composed of oak wood, the whisky has a collection of fruit, vanilla, and honey flavors.

name: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old
notes: The Glenfiddich is matured in American Oak and European Oak Casks for a minimum of 12 years. This provides it’s signature sweet and subtle oak flavors.

name: Cardhu 12 Year Old, 1 Litre
notes: The Cardhu 12 is enticingly silky smooth with notes of delicate fruity character and golden honey. This single malt is best served neat or over ice to bring out the smooth honeyed flavours.

name: Johnnie Walker Double Black
notes: The Johnnie Walker Double Black is inspired by the Johnnie Walker Black Label. This whisky adds more profile by including heavily charred Islay whiskey and casks.

name: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve
notes: The Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve is a hallmark Johnnie Walker blend that brings together Speyside and Highland whiskies. With notes of vanilla and dark fruit, this high-end blend is a perfect addition to your night of celebration.

name: Johnnie Walker Black Label
notes: Recognized as the benchmark for all other deluxe blends, Johnnie Walker Black Label is a true icon. Created using only whiskies aged for a minimum of 12 years from the four corners of Scotland, Johnnie Walker Black Label has an unmistakably smooth, deep character.

name: Royal Salute 21 Year Old
notes: The Royal Salute 21 Year Old was created to commemorate the coronation of Her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth II. This exceptional whisky is named after the 21 guns fired at the Tower of London.

name: Johnnie Walker Red Label
notes: Johnnie Walker Red Label is Johnnie Walker’s pioneer blend. The versatile one that has introduced Johnnie Walker whisky to the world.

name: Jack Daniels Tennessee Whiskey, 750ml
notes: Jack Daniel’s Black Label (also known as Old No. 7 or more commonly as JD or simply Jack) is one of the best selling whiskeys in the world.

name: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old
notes: Smooth, rich, and generous are the perfect three words to describe a Chivas Regal 12 Year Old whisky. Comprised of malt and grain whiskies that have been aged for a minimum of 12 Year Old, the whisky has notes of vanilla, ripe apple, and honey.

name: Celebration Vodka
notes: Sharing in the post-War euphoria, IDL decided to name a new product to commemorate the coming of peace. Thus, Celebration Vodka was born.

name: Eristoff Triple Distilled Vodka
notes: Eristoff Vodka is a triple distilled premium vodka made from 100% pure grain. It’s based on a secret recipe created in Georgia, historically referred to as ‘The Land Of The Wolf.

name: Absolut Vodka
notes: Manufactured in the only facility in Sweden, the Absolut Vodka is made with 100% natural ingredients an no sugar. The vodka has a mellow taste that perfecly accompanies any cocktails.

name: Ciroc Vodka
notes: The Ciroc Vodka is fermented from French grapes in an innovative cold fermentation process. The spirit is then distilled five times to achieve the epitome of smoothness.

name: Russian Standard Original Vodka
notes: Hailing from the home of vodka – Russia, the Russian Standard Vodka is the benchmark for excellenct vodka. Distillided multiple times and filtered four times with charcoal, the spirit is exceptionally pure and delicious.

name: Smirnoff Red, 350ml
notes: Triple distilled and filtered 10 times, the Smirnoff is the world’s best-selling vodka. Crystal clear in colour, the vodka has faint aromas of black pepper and charcoal.

name: Camino Real Blanco Tequila
notes: The agaves used in making Camino Real grow in fields at 2,000 metres above sea level, hence the name Camino, i.e. ?high? in Spanish.Thanks to its pure taste, Camino Real Tequila Blanco is suitable for several tequila-based cocktails.

name: Danzante Prosecco Spumante Brut
notes: The Danzante Prosecco is the epitome of Italian winemaking. The wine is intensely fruity and is pleasantly fresh fresh and balanced in the mouth.

name: Moet and Chandon Imperial Brut
notes: A champagne that need no introduction, the Moet & Chandon Imperial Brut Champagne embodies unique style, distinguished fruitness, and elegant maturity. Synonymous with celebrations and achievements, the champagne has intense notes of green apple and citrus fruits.

name: Jacobs Creek Sparkling Chardonnay Pinot Noir
notes: The red fruit flavours of the pinot noir blend perfectly with the citrus notes of the Chardonnay to bring together the Jacob’s Creek Sparkling Chardonnay Pinot Noir.

name: Rockland Dark Red Rum
notes: A full-bodied rum made in a typical Jamaican style. Recognized by its distinct taste and aroma with flavour and aroma notes of raisin cake with golden syrup and dark chocolate.

name: Rockland White Rum
notes: Rockland White Rum is accepted as one of the finest white rums available in Sri Lanka. A broad, medium length palate, light bodied but with a fresh sugarcane flavour and character.

name: Calypso Gold Red Rum
notes: Matured in oak vats and crafted with high quality sugar cane spirits, the Calypso rum is fortified with indgredients to make it a party favourite.

name: Havana Club Rum, 3 Year Old
notes: First made in 1934, The Havana Club is crafted?in the isle of rum – Cuba. The rum is aged for three years with light fruity flavours, and hints of oak.

name: Bacardi Carta Blanca Rum – Local
notes: A classic white rum with distinctive vanilla and almond notes developed in white oak barrels and shaped through a secret blend of charcoal for a distinctive smoothness. This rum is manufactured in Sri Lanka by International Distilleries Limited under the license of Bacardi.

name: Bacardi Carta Blanca Superior White Rum – Imported
notes: The Bacardi Carta Blanca Superior White Rum is classic white rum with distinctive vanilla and almond notes. Developed in white oak barrels and shaped through a secret blend of charcoal, the rum has a distinct smoothness.

name: Captain Morgan Original Spiced Gold Rum
notes: The Captain Morgan Original Spiced Gold Rum is a secret blend of Caribbean rums. This spiced rum has subtle notes of vanilla and caramel giving classic rum cocktails a distinctive, flavourful finish.

name: Campari Liqueur, 750ml
notes: The Campari Liqueur is made from the infusion of herbs and fruits such as Chinotto and Cascarilla in alcohol and water. It is bitter, characterised by its dark red colour.

name: Jagermeister
notes: German products are synoymous with high quality and the Jagermeister is no different. Blending 56 botanicals, this herbal liqueur was first blended in 1878 and the ingredients remain a closely guarded secret to date.

name: Baileys Irish Cream
notes: The first and original Irish Cream – Baileys Irish Cream is flavoured with pure Irish whiskey, proprietary cocoa, and cream made from near 40,000 Irish cows. The drink is so versatile that you can mix it with everything, you also add it to your desserts!.

name: Rockland Dry Gin
notes: A gin with a subtle taste of juniper and select spices made according to a secret family recipe handed down over four generations. The Rockland Gin label is as distinct as its Gin; the purple is a reflection of the juniper used in the recipe and remains virtually unchanged since Rockland’s first made gin.

name: Ascot London Dry Gin
notes: The finest botanical and high quality imported spirits melt together to create one of the finest Gins, which as its name suggests, is associated with refinement and style. Ascot Dry Gin is crisp and dry with hints of Juniper berry and citrus notes.

name: Bulldog Gin – London Dry Gin
notes: The Bulldog Gin is infused with a seductive merge of natural botanicals such as Dragon Eye, Poppy and Lotus leaves, making for a very aromatic gin. Spicy, on the palate you will find cinnamon, cardamom and citrus leaving you with a warm finish.

name: Beefeater Gin
notes: Made in the heart of London, the Beefeater Gin is still made to the nearly 200 year old original recipe of 9 botanicals. The Beefeater London Dry Gin is also the world’s most awarded gin (Based on International Spirit Awards from 2004 to 2019).

name: Hendricks Gin
notes: The Hendrick’s Gin is infused with more than 11 botanicals coupled with essences of rose and cucumber to form a uniquely distilled gin. The gin is made in batches of 500 liters at a time to control the quality of the range.

name: Gordons Dry Gin
notes: An absolute classic dry gin, Gordon’s Dry Gin is one of the best selling spirits in the world. This triple-distilled gin is made from botanicals such as juniper berries, coriander, Angelica.

name: Colombo No 7 Gin
notes: Colombo No 7 Gin was invented out of necessity when spice trade routes were closed during the second world war. Crafted to a 70 year old timeless recipe including four botanicals native to Sri Lanka, this gin wrecked the stereotype that a good gin cannot be produced outside the UK.

name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin
notes: Distilled four times to achieve perfection, The Tanqueray London Dry Gin expertly combines handcrafted and carefully selected botanicals such as juniper, angelica, licorice, and coriander to the worlds most awarded gin.

name: Wincarnis Tonic Wine
notes: First produced in 1887, Wincarnis Tonic Wine is a natural tonic, incorporating a unique infusion of herbs and spices. It is also rich in vitamins, especially energy-giving Vitamins.

name: Ritz Cherry Brandy
notes: Matured in French Oak Barrels to capture the brightness and elegance on the palate, the Ritz Cherry Brandy combines the traditional and modern distillation methods.

name: Galerie Brandy
notes: Premium aged finest French Brandy combined with fine premium spirits in vats to enhance and give its elegance.

name: Ritz Brandy
notes: The intense bouquet of succulent red cherries mixed with oak aged Brandy makes this liqueur an all time favorite. It?s a perfect mix for many cocktails and is ideal for confectionery with its strong notes of juicy red cherries.

name: Hennessy VS Cognac
notes: Arguably one of the best know cognacs in the world, the Hennessy Very Special (VS) is a bold and fragrant. This cognac is matured on Oak barrels giving toasted and fruity notes.

name: Martell Cognac VS
notes: The Martell VS Cognac (Very Special Cognac) has stood the test of time to be seen as a bright young cognac despite being created over 150 years ago. Great for making cocktails!.

name: Carlsberg Premium Pilsner, 330ml Can
notes: The international flavours of global brewers Carlsberg, is produced at the Lion Brewery under license, adding further dimensions to the portfolio of products on offer, is available in 4.8%.

name: Carlsberg Premium Pilsner, 500ml Can
notes: The international flavours of global brewers Carlsberg, is produced at the Lion Brewery under license, adding further dimensions to the portfolio of products on offer, is available in 4.8%.

name: Tiger Crystal, 330ml Bottle
notes: Tiger Crystal is a recent innovation under the Tiger brand ? Popularized as a premium beer; Tiger Crystal is a light, smooth and refreshing beer at 4.2% alcohol by volume (ABV) that has a robust flavor and a faint apple scented aroma followed by a clean aftertaste. Brewed from natural ingredients and specially imported hops from USA warrants a light, refreshing and low in bitterness lager suited for any palette and a perfect choice for thirst quenching occasions.

name: Lion Lager, 330ml Can
notes: Undoubtedly Sri Lanka’s best selling mild beers, Lion Lager has a 4.8% alcohol volume and is credited as a great thirst quencher. Golden roasted malt in colour with a hint of fruit and caramel flavouring, it is very slightly sweet with less hop notes.

name: Lion Lager, 500ml Can
notes: Undoubtedly Sri Lanka’s best selling mild beers, Lion Lager has a 4.8% alcohol volume and is credited as a great thirst quencher. Golden roasted malt in colour with a hint of fruit and caramel flavouring, it is very slightly sweet with less hop notes.

name: Corona Extra 330ml Bottle
notes: Brewed using the finest ingredients of filtered water, hops, malted barley, yeast, and corn, the Corona Extra has fruity-honey aromas with a dash of malt. Mexico brewed since 1925.

name: IDL Gold Label Premium Arrack
notes: Gold Label is without equal. Combining the artistry of our Master Blender with only the best coconut spirits, drawn from our Hamilla and Teak vats and finished with the finest ?double-gold? imported spirits.

name: DCSL Narikela
notes: With the aroma of desiccated coconut coupled with subtle sweetness, Narikela is best served as a cocktail mixer.

name: DCSL Sri Lanka Arrack
notes: A 100% coconut spirit, matured in Halmilla vats, producing a woody character and exceptional smoothness.

name: IDL Blue Sapphire
notes: Combines traditional coconut arrack character with subtle note of whiskey aged in wood.

name: Rockland Old Arrack – Extra Strong
notes: Rockland Old Arrack is specially distilled to give a medium bodied drink. Matured in wooden Hamilla vats, the arrack is blend of different ages and has a distinct arrack aroma and flavour.

name: DCSL Double Distilled Arrack
notes: Twice distilled in pot stills and matured slowly in Halmilla vats giving a remarkable taste and aroma.

name: DCSL VSOA (Very Special Old Arrack)
notes: Very Special Old Arrack ? 100% Pure Distilled Coconut Arrack. Recognised by its rich, aroma, full, smooth palate and exceptionally well-rounded falvour, this presentation of Very Special Old Arrack is an improved blend of distinguished character.

name: Argente 20 Year Old Arrack
notes: The Argente 20 Year Old Arrack is inspired by Scotch Whisky. When it comes to Scotch, the age statement constitutes to the youngest spirit in the blend.

name: Ceylon Arrack Special
notes: Distilled from the sap of the coconut flower and aged in Halmilla Wood. Ceylon Arrack is one of Sri Lanka’s finest Arracks.

name: Old Reserve – Rare 47
notes: The culmination of perfection in the Old Reserve range, the Old Reserve Rare 47 has a deep resonant sensation on the palate and the senses.

name: Old Reserve – Real 34
notes: Old Reserve 34 is unrivalled as Sri Lanka?s favourite pure coconut spirit blend. And not without reason.
